About HUTCHISON PORTS MÉXICO
----------------------------

Con una trayectoria exitosa a lo largo de 20 años, Hutchison Ports es el operador internacional de puertos con una auténtica red global extendida en 25 países, filial de la multinacional CK Hutchison Holdings Limited. Hutchison Ports ha liderado el sector a lo largo de 150 años marcando los estándares de la industria portuaria ofreciendo servicios en Veracruz, Manzanillo, Ensenada, Lázaro Cárdenas, Tula Hidalgo y Cd de México. En Hutchison Ports entregamos lo mejor de nuestro servicio a través de nuestros colaboradores, cuidando lo que más aprecian nuestros clientes y socios: sus cargas. Nuestro éxito está probado a través de generaciones y continentes. Nos enfocamos en el futuro, no sólo en el presente. Ofrecemos servicios a la medida del cliente, desarrollamos relaciones comerciales y humanas de largo plazo construyendo confianza en cada uno de los puertos donde operamos.En Hutchison Ports seguimos cultivando valores como la innovación, la transparencia, la información en tiempo real y el servicio oportuno, práctico, eficaz y a la medida, para brindar experiencias extraordinarias a nuestros clientes. Lo anterior se logra con el toque humano de quienes a través de una actitud empática y cercana, hacemos que en Hutchison Ports seamos aliados estratégicos, flexibles y sensibles en nuestro enfoque al cliente, al brindar soluciones a tus necesidades.

About PACT Pharma
-----------------

At PACT Pharma, our vision is to create potentially curative T cell therapies for solid cancers that are tailored for each and every patient.  
  
We are pioneering non-viral, precision-genome engineered, tumor-specific T-cell therapies for cancer patients because we envision a world where everyone has access to personalized treatment regardless of who they are and where they come from. We currently focus on treating solid tumors.  
  
PACT Pharma believes that the only way forward is together, and we look for individuals to join our team who share our values. Teamwork and humility are highly prized. So is speaking with kindness. Be ready to share your ideas, because we create a culture that listens to ideas and isn’t afraid to implement them.  
  
If you have a passion for turning ideas into realities and seek a work environment where your colleagues are equally engaged and enthusiastic, you’ll want to join us.  
  
If you desire a stimulating fast-paced environment, working with intelligent people who are making an impact in cancer, you will want to join the PACT Pharma team. We are a rapidly expanding, innovative, and collaborative workforce working towards one main goal, eradicating cancer!  
  
We are in the San Francisco bay area, the heart of the world’s premier biotechnology research hub. PACT Pharma offers a competitive compensation and benefits package, including participation in the aggressive growth of the company in the form of stock option grants.

Principled. Progressive. The Nation speaks truth to power to build a more just society.  
  
Home to tenacious muckraking, provocative commentary, and spirited debate about politics and culture, The Nation empowers readers to fight for justice and equality for all. By providing a deeper understanding of the world as it is—and as it could be—we drive bold ideas into the conversation and ignite debates far beyond our pages.  
  
We believe in intellectual freedom. We value facts and transparency. We argue that dissent is patriotic and we hold the powerful to account, no matter their political persuasion. We raise up the promise of a radical tomorrow while we agitate for meaningful change today. Above all, we aspire to galvanize a more informed public—one equipped with a more profound understanding of events, ideas, and history.  
  
Founded by abolitionists in 1865, we’ve long believed that independent journalism has the capacity to bring about a more democratic and equitable world. Our writers shift paradigms and open minds. Our deep investigative reporting launches congressional hearings, forces policy change, and shapes news cycles. Instigating progress: It’s not only our legacy, it’s our continued commitment to future generations of torchbearers.

About Norsk-Global (Norsk European Wholesale Ltd)
-------------------------------------------------

Norsk-Global (Norsk European Wholesale Ltd), headquartered at 2 Willow Road, Slough, Berks, United Kingdom, has been a trusted name in wholesale delivery services since its inception in 1993. With a commitment to excellence, Norsk provides a comprehensive range of logistics solutions across Europe, Eastern Europe, and Scandinavia, while also extending its services globally for a true 'one-stop' shop experience. The company specializes in next-day delivery options, ensuring that businesses can rely on timely shipments to maintain their competitive edge.  
  
Norsk's extensive portfolio includes a variety of services tailored to meet the needs of diverse industries, including e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, and more. By leveraging cutting-edge technology, Norsk has refined its operations to offer real-time tracking and accurate delivery information, enhancing the customer experience. The company’s dedicated Customer Services team, many of whom have been with Norsk since its founding, brings a wealth of specialist knowledge to handle inquiries and provide tailored solutions.  
  
Norsk's extensive network of partners throughout Europe allows for unparalleled coverage and some of the earliest delivery options available in the market. This strategic collaboration not only enhances service reliability but also positions Norsk as a formidable competitor against larger integrators. With a focus on quality, dependability, and customer satisfaction, Norsk-Global continues to evolve, ensuring that businesses can trust their logistics needs to a partner that prioritizes service excellence.

Behnam Mehmanpazir, as the Founder and President of Synthesis Technologies Inc., is at the forefront of innovation in the cycling and culinary industries. With a mission to enhance and extend biking experiences while creating exceptional culinary offerings, Behnam has successfully integrated his expertise in product marketing, business development, and project management to drive the company's vision forward. Under his leadership, Synthesis Technologies has launched key projects that resonate with both cycling enthusiasts and food lovers alike.  
  
One of Behnam's notable initiatives is the Siskiyou Cyclery, an independent bicycle dealer that not only provides high-quality bicycles but also fosters a community of cyclists through events and workshops. His strategic approach to product management and development has allowed the cyclery to curate a diverse range of biking products that cater to various skill levels and preferences. Additionally, Behnam's involvement with Xerxes Mediterranean Grill showcases his commitment to creating good eats, where he leverages his skills in financial reporting and forecasting to ensure the restaurant's profitability and growth.  
  
Moreover, Behnam is also the driving force behind Xerxes Seeds International, a pioneering company specializing in hybrid tomato seeds. His business analysis and financial modeling expertise have been instrumental in positioning Xerxes Seeds as a leader in agricultural innovation. By combining his passion for cycling and culinary arts with a robust understanding of market dynamics, Behnam Mehmanpazir continues to make significant contributions to the industries he serves, fostering a culture of excellence and sustainability.

About Corvuss American Academy
------------------------------

Corvuss American Academy is the first of its kind international boarding school in India for student athletes. Borrowing from best practices of US prep schools and academies in Europe, Corvuss has developed an integrated program, which combines academics and elite sports training, under one roof, for students from grades 6 to 12.  
  
We are committed to helping girls and boys talented in sports develop their skills to their fullest potential, pursue an internationally recognised academic degree and leverage their athletic and academic abilities to pursue admissions in colleges globally.  
  
Students will pursue the US high school curriculum and have the option to take Advanced Placement (AP) courses in senior school. The school will provide training programs in seven elite sports - Basketball, Cricket, Football, Squash, Swimming, Tennis, Track and Field - which have been developed under the mentorship of our internationally renowned sports partners.  
  
The 44-acre state of the art Corvuss campus is located in Karjat, Maharashtra, close to Mumbai and Pune. Surrounded by lush trees, and views of the Matheran hills, our campus is a self-sustaining haven for student athletes. The safety of student athletes and every member of the Corvuss community is important to us. Our campus design, rules and regulations and use of technology will ensure that we provide our student athletes a world-class environment in which they can grow and thrive.  
  
Contact us to learn more and see if Corvuss American Academy can help your son or daughter in their academic and athletic journeys!

The business continues to grow through the tough economic period and has over 45% market share of residential new homes market. It continues to work with its customers to introduce innovative windows and door products that inspire design and add value to homes.  
  
Its commercial operations continue to grow and have now seen successful ventures into the Pilbara with work being carried out on two large scale projects for BHPB and Icon Apartments.  
  
The business moved into purpose built manufacturing premises in July 2010, and now has enjoys increased manufacturing capacities and expanded its glass processing capacities to include its own Toughening facility and Double-Glazing line.

Ultimately, he agreed to play for the University of Kentucky under head coach John Calipari, joining a powerhouse program that was known for developing top-tier talent.  
  
During his freshman year at Kentucky, Kidd-Gilchrist's impact was immediate. His relentless work ethic and unselfish approach to the game endeared him to fans and teammates alike, setting the stage for a promising future in professional basketball.  
  
Following his successful collegiate career, Kidd-Gilchrist declared for the NBA draft and was selected second overall by the Charlotte Bobcats (now Hornets) in 2012. His transition to the professional ranks was marked by the same relentless work ethic and defensive tenacity that had defined his playing style in college. Throughout his time with the Hornets, Kidd-Gilchrist became known for his defensive prowess, often drawing the assignment of guarding the opposing team's best player. His ability to disrupt passing lanes, contest shots, and lock down opponents made him a valuable asset on the court.  
  
Though he struggled with injuries at times, Kidd-Gilchrist's commitment to his team and his unwavering dedication to improving never wavered. He continued to be a reliable contributor for the Hornets, providing energy and leadership on and off the court. His impact extended beyond statistics, as his presence and attitude positively influenced his teammates and helped establish a culture of hard work and determination within the organization.  
  
After spending several seasons with the Hornets, Kidd-Gilchrist was traded to the Dallas Mavericks during the 2019-2020 season. Though his time in Dallas was brief, he continued to bring his trademark intensity and defensive acumen to the court. Despite facing adversity and injury setbacks, Kidd-Gilchrist's determination never wavered, showcasing his resilience and commitment to the game he loved.  
  
In early 2021, Kidd-Gilchrist made the decision to step away from professional basketball, marking the end of his playing career. Though his time on the court had come to a close, his impact and influence on the game would continue to be felt. As a former standout athlete, Kidd-Gilchrist's legacy would endure as a testament to the power of hard work, perseverance, and dedication to one's craft.  
  
Off the court, Kidd-Gilchrist has remained active in his philanthropic efforts, giving back to communities and causes that are important to him. His commitment to making a positive impact extends beyond his playing days, showcasing a well-rounded individual who is dedicated to making a difference in the lives of others.  
  
As a former basketball player, Michael Kidd-Gilchrist left an indelible mark on the game with his relentless work ethic, defensive prowess, and unselfish approach to the game. At Fresh Service we specialise in the storage and distribution of fresh produce from worldwide growers, exporters and importers, with particular expertise in delivering to the UK wholesale markets.

We have storage space for approx. 4,000 pallets in our multi-temperature controlled warehouses and we’re open 24 hours a day in order to process incoming and outgoing time-critical produce to ensure its quality.

About HFI Pyrotechnics Inc.
---------------------------

HFI Pyrotechnics (formerly Hands Fireworks) has been creating commercial pyrotechnics since 1873, when it was founded by William Hand.  
  
HFI was initially a fireworks manufacturer and then transitioned into a specialty pyrotechnics supplier for the Canadian Military developing a wide range of specialty pyrotechnic products to meet the needs of the global Defence and Security market.  
  
As a leader in the design and manufacturing of specialty pyrotechnics products, HFI’s products are used around the world by military and commercial clients to meet their specific needs for safety, steadfast reliability and cost-effective performance.  
  
For over 144 years, HFI has provided the greatest quality, performance and value that our clients have come to expect and is Canada's premier producer and supplier of military quality, specialty pyrotechnics products and services for military and commercial use.  
  
HFI Pyrotechnics provides cost-effective, safe and trusted Pyrotechnic Engineering and Production services for the global Defence and Security Market:  
  
Technology Research and Development  
Engineering and Design  
Manufacturing and Assembly  
Production conversion Engineering and Design  
Test, Proof and Acceptance  
Quality Management, Inspection and Failure Analysis  
Operator and Ammunition Technician Training and Training Support  
Logistics and Supply Chain Management (Storage and Transportation)  
Waste and Salvage Recovery and Disposal  
Hazard and Risk Analysis and Management

About giffgaff
--------------

We're up to good  
It's simple really. At giffgaff, doing good is our thing.  
  
In 2008, our founder decided that there was a better way to do mobile. And just like that, giffgaff was born. Since then, we’ve been doing mobile our own way.  
  
We put the power back in our members' hands, with flexible plans for all. From pay as you go, to monthly rolling, to good contracts, we make it easy for everyone to stay connected.  
  
And by the way, we’re powered by the O2 network.  
  
But the goodness doesn’t stop there.  
  
In 2022, 75% of all the phones we sold were refurbished, which is a win for our members’ pockets and helps them to be more sustainable.  
  
Together with our members, we’ve also supported people all over the UK in need of a helping hand, from large charities to smaller local ones.  
  
In fact, the word “giffgaff” is actually Scots for “mutual giving”. Rolls right off the tongue, don’t you think?  
  
If you like the sound of us and would like to join us, then check out our latest jobs.

About Sports Events & Tourism Association
-----------------------------------------

As the non-profit 501(c)3 trade association for the sports events and tourism industry in the United States, the Sports Events & Tourism Association (Sports ETA) is the most essential resource for sports commissions, sports destinations, vendors, and sports event owners. We believe sport tourism and the events that our members own and host have the power to transform society for the better. Our passion is to help sport tourism professionals achieve previously unimaginable levels of performance. We do this by nurturing a community of smart, creative, and interesting people: our members.  
Our organizational members are sports commissions, destination marketing organizations (DMOs), parks and recreation departments, chambers of commerce, national governing bodies (NGBs), multi-sport organizations (MSOs), and vendors to the sports events and tourism industry. More than 2,500 individuals from more than 800-member organizations lead, manage, and execute sports events of all shapes and sizes - from bowling tournaments to the Super Bowl, and U-12 girls soccer tournaments to the Women's World Cup. Together, they create opportunities for athletes young and old to participate in the sports they love and lead healthy, active lifestyles. Sports ETA is the most trusted resource for sports commissions, destination marketing organizations (DMOs), vendors, and sports event owners.  
Since being established in 1992, our promise has been to deliver quality education, ample networking opportunities and exceptional event management and marketing know-how to our members, and to protect the integrity of the sports events and tourism industry.

Pinnacle Pet UK  
  
We are part of the Pinnacle Pet Group (PPG) – a pan-European fully-integrated pet insurance and health services platform. PPG aims to create the leading pet health services and insurance platform globally, along with our partners in North America. Pinnacle Pet UK is a top 5 UK pet insurer with a clear ambition to be the leading pet health-care and insurance services partner in the UK. Working with key partners and recognised brands, we have established a track record for delivering insurance products and services that provide value and support to our pet parents. But that’s just the beginning…  
  
Our mission  
  
We believe happy, healthy pets make happy parents. This is at the heart of everything we do. Through the products and services we provide, our purpose is to give pet parents peace of mind so they can live life to the full with their four-legged friends.  
  
Our brands and services  
  
We partner with some of the UK's most respected and established brands, and together we share a strong ethical commitment to ensure we provide value and support the needs of pet parents. We have built a team of experienced professionals dedicated to offering an optimised end-to-end customer experience based upon a drive for continuous improvement.  
  
Our values  
  
Our values are central to how we think and work together as a team. Our ambition is to create a truly exceptional service for our customers, built on collaboration, individuality, passion and trust.  
  
The eight core values which drive us:  
  
· Customer first  
· One team focus  
· Creativity and innovation  
· Integrity and transparency  
· Energy and passion  
· Trust  
· Fun  
· Respect

About The Recovery Research Network
-----------------------------------

Saving Lives by Helping Individuals Achieve Remission from Addiction.  
  
The outpatient substance use disorder treatment program at TRRN uses a broad range of treatment approaches in order to tailor treatment to individual needs. Using the Remission Outcome (RO) Measure, TRRN is able to track your progress as you work to achieve your recovery goals.  
  
  
TRRN has developed a unique outpatient treatment platform for individuals dealing with substance use disorder. Utilizing this treatment platform, TRRN aims drive superior patient outcomes, while building an efficient and effective paradigm.  
  
TRRN’s treatment platform integrates a novel, multi-phase treatment program, a proprietary software for collecting and analyzing longitudinal patient outcomes, and a translational clinical research program, in order to support long-term recovery.  
  
TRRN’s executive team has a comprehensive understanding of how to effectively build integrative models of individualized treatment, research, and community-based educational programs to advocate, advance and create awareness of our understanding of addiction and promote long-term recovery.

About U.S. Army Center for Army Analysis
----------------------------------------

Official Page of the U.S. Army Center for Army Analysis (CAA).  
  
A Field Operating Agency of the Deputy Chief of Staff, G-8, CAA conducts decision support analysis across the spectrum of conflict, in a Joint, Inter-agency, Inter-governmental, and Multinational context to inform critical senior level decisions for current and future national security issues. CAA is a recognized authority on the independent analysis of land warfare interests in a joint and combined context at the operational-strategic levels.  
  
CAA conducts a wide variety of analyses including; establishing requirements and evaluating force structure, design, and capabilities in the context of joint/combined forces for theater, low-intensity, and contingency operations; assessing force modernization programs, affordability, requirements, and tradeoffs supporting Army inputs to the Planning, Programming, Budgeting and Execution System; analysis of combat support and service support systems, logistics, and personnel; assessing strategic concepts, alternative strategies, and military options; conducting workshops, tabletop exercises, and political-military wargaming; applying optimization methods to evaluate installation and stationing problems; developing and maintaining scenarios, models, databases, and techniques necessary to support CAA’s analytical mission and functions.  
  
A sub-component of CAA, the U.S. Army Modeling and Simulation Office (AMSO), is the Army’s enterprise-level organization for modeling and simulation (M&S) policy, coordination and workforce management. AMSO develops the strategy and policy for the Army M&S enterprise; executes effective governance and resource management through leadership and synchronization; leads coordination of the Army M&S enterprise and cross-community areas including Joint, Inter-agency, Inter-governmental, and Multinational environments, Industry and Academia; and trains, educates and manages the Army analysis and M&S workforce (both military & civilian).

As a customer focused terminal we look to deliver a quality services but in an efficient manner to support just-in-time onward deliveries to the London market.

The station is recognized year after year for outstanding coverage of breaking news, severe weather and investigative reporting.  
  
NewsChannel 5 Investigates is one of the most highly acclaimed investigative units in the country. The team’s mission is to hold the powerful accountable, and in the process, they have won a national award for their work every year since 2009 – from the National Headliner, to the DuPont and the Peabody.  
  
SKY5 helicopter sets NewsChannel 5 apart from our competition -- providing the only full time aerial coverage of breaking news, severe weather, and traffic. Its gyro-stabilized camera produces spectacular images that viewers can’t get anywhere else.  
  
Nashville is most notably known as the center of the music industry, earning it the nickname Music City. Nashville is also a center for the health care, banking and transportation industries and is home to a large number of colleges and universities including Vanderbilt University. Nashville was named Friendliest City in 2016 by Travel & Leisure.  
  
The Nashville region's business environment is characterized by a favorable geographic location, quality workforce, lower taxes, and growth opportunities enhanced by a diverse economy. Over the last decade, the Nashville area has experienced tremendous growth across industry sectors, including the major industries of health care, tourism, publishing and music. High-profile businesses from across the country and the globe have moved to the Nashville area in the past few years, including ServiceSource, Eventbrite, Under Armour, Backyard Burgers, Nissan and the Consulate-General of Japan. Nashville is also home to several Fortune 500 companies.

About Tee It Up for the Troops
------------------------------

Tee It Up For The Troops, Inc. is a 501(c)3 organization established in 2005 by the family and friends of a soldier who enlisted in the U.S. Army after September 11, 2001. When the son was asked by his father what he needed, the son responded by asking his father to do something for the soldiers and their families back home. TEE IT UP FOR THE TROOPS, INC. was created to honor that request and to recognize the needs of all veterans who have served and continue to serve this great nation.  
  
Since 2005, Tee It Up for the Troops has been engaging and inspiring communities across the United States to do great things on behalf of the military men and women who have served and sacrificed so much for our freedoms. Since its inception, thousands of volunteers have stepped up to the tee to help organize over 415 fundraising events in over 40 states across the nation.  
  
Through mainly golf events, Tee It Up for the Troops not only connects transitioning veterans to their communities but has also donated in excess of $10,000,000 to veteran service organizations delivering critically needed services to returning veterans and their families.  
  
Tee It Up for the Troops is proficient in our governance of the funds entrusted to our care to fulfill our mission to honor, remember, respect and support all those who have served in the Armed Forces for our great nation.

They utilize multiple gateways and redundancy protocols to minimize downtime and ensure messages are delivered promptly. Additionally, their monitoring systems track performance metrics, allowing for quick resolution of any issues that may arise.

What kind of support does MX Telecom provide for its services?

MX Telecom offers comprehensive support for all its services, including technical assistance, account management, and customer service. About LifeStream Behavioral Center
----------------------------------

LifeStream is a behavioral health and social services organization that provides high-quality treatment, education, care management, rehabilitation, child welfare, primary care and homeless services to children, adolescents, and adults. Located in Central Florida, LifeStream primarily serves the residents of Lake, Citrus and Sumter Counties, with additional programs located in Orange, Marion, Hernando and Hillsborough Counties.  
  
Beginning in 1969 as a component of Waterman Memorial Hospital in Eustis, LifeStream became an independent non-profit organization in 1971. Since then, LifeStream has grown to twenty-eight facilities and fifty-two programs to help those who suffer from mental illness and substance abuse achieve recovery and resiliency.  
  
Over the years LifeStream has helped hundreds of thousands of individuals across our community. In Fiscal Year 2019 alone, LifeStream provided services for 27,060 unduplicated clients. Total visits of 359,699. Yet with tens of thousands of individuals in need across our community going untreated each year, LifeSteam’s volunteers and staff remain committed to reaching out and empowering individuals to achieve recovery and resiliency in their own lives.

Michael Gira is an American singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist known for his powerful and haunting musical style. With his deep, resonant voice and intense stage presence, Gira quickly established himself as a commanding figure in the world of alternative music.  
  
In addition to his work with Swans, Gira has also embarked on a successful solo career, releasing several critically acclaimed albums that showcase his diverse range of musical talents. Drawing on influences ranging from folk and blues to industrial and experimental rock, Gira's solo work is marked by its raw emotional intensity and unflinching lyrical honesty.  
  
One of the most striking aspects of Gira's music is its dark, brooding atmosphere, which is often underscored by his arresting vocal delivery and evocative, hypnotic instrumentation. His songs are filled with vivid, visceral imagery and a sense of profound introspection, making them both deeply personal and universally relatable. Gira's music has a distinct, almost otherworldly quality that sets it apart from the mainstream, and fans of his work often find themselves drawn into a world of intense, immersive emotion.  
  
Gira's talents as a multi-instrumentalist are also on full display in his solo work, as he showcases his skills as a guitarist, pianist, and arranger. His compositions are rich and complex, incorporating a wide variety of musical textures and influences to create a sound that is at once both familiar and completely original. Gira's ability to weave together disparate elements into a cohesive musical tapestry is a testament to his creative vision and technical prowess.  
  
Beyond his musical talents, Gira is also a thought-provoking and eloquent lyricist, writing songs that touch on themes of love, loss, redemption, and existential struggle. His lyrics are often deeply poetic and esoteric, inviting listeners to ponder the deeper meanings behind his words. Gira's ability to connect with his audience on such a profound level is a testament to his skill as a storyteller and a communicator, and it's one of the many reasons he has earned such a devoted fanbase.  
  
In addition to his solo work, Gira has also collaborated with a wide range of artists across the musical spectrum, from experimental jazz musicians to avant-garde composers. His willingness to push the boundaries of his own sound and explore new artistic territory has made him a respected figure in the avant-garde music community, and his influence can be felt in the work of countless contemporary artists.  
  
Overall, Michael Gira is an artist who defies easy categorization, and his music continues to resonate with listeners around the world. Whether he's commanding the stage with Swans or crafting deeply personal and introspective solo albums, Gira's work is bound to leave a lasting impression on anyone who encounters it. His fearless exploration of the human experience and his unyielding commitment to his artistic vision make him a true musical pioneer, and his impact on the world of alternative and experimental music is undeniable.

What is Glitch and how does it work?

Glitch is an online platform that allows users to create, remix, and share web applications and websites easily. It provides a collaborative environment where users can write code, see changes in real-time, and interact with a community of creators. Users can start from scratch or remix existing projects, making it accessible for both beginners and experienced developers.

What types of projects can I create on Glitch?

On Glitch, you can create a wide range of web projects, including static websites, dynamic web applications, APIs, and bots. The platform supports various programming languages and frameworks, such as JavaScript, Node.js, and HTML/CSS, allowing for diverse project types. Whether you're building a personal portfolio, a game, or a complex application, Glitch provides the tools you need.

Is Glitch suitable for team collaboration?

Yes, Glitch is designed with collaboration in mind. It allows multiple users to work on the same project simultaneously, making it ideal for teams. You can invite team members to join your project, track changes, and communicate within the platform. This makes Glitch a great choice for group projects, hackathons, and educational settings.

What resources does Glitch offer for beginners?

Glitch provides a variety of resources to help beginners get started, including tutorials, documentation, and a supportive community. The platform features starter projects that users can remix and learn from, as well as an extensive help center that covers common questions and coding concepts. Additionally, the community forum is a great place to ask questions and share knowledge.

Can I use Glitch for commercial projects?

Yes, you can use Glitch for commercial projects. The platform allows you to build and deploy applications that can be monetized or used for business purposes. However, it's important to review Glitch's terms of service to ensure compliance with any specific guidelines related to commercial use.

What kind of support does Glitch provide for developers?

Glitch offers several support options for developers, including a comprehensive help center with articles and guides, a community forum for peer support, and direct assistance through their contact form. Additionally, the platform encourages users to share their projects and seek feedback, fostering a collaborative environment where developers can learn from each other.

About Virtus Partners, LLC
--------------------------

Virtus Partners provides solutions for asset managers, banks, hedge funds, and investors to better manage a wide variety of alternative investment strategies. We understand that different clients may require different solutions, so our services are flexible and tailored to fit your specific requirements. We work with a range of clientele, from fixed-income managers to hedge fund software providers.  
Headquartered in Houston, Texas the company has grown from a four person firm in 2005 to a global leader in our industry. We have leveraged our bank debt expertise to expand beyond the CLO market and offer a comprehensive set of solutions covering the broader alternative investment landscape. Today, over 300 employees in five offices in the United States and Europe administer over $350 B dollars worth of assets for over 100 global financial institutions.  
  
CLIENTS  
Virtus has a large and growing client base consisting of many of the world’s largest banks, hedge funds and asset managers. The deals that Virtus administers on behalf of these clients typically have lives of 5-7 years and are recurring in nature. Virtus is administering over 750 individual portfolios for 100 different managers. Over half of our clients have multiple deals with Virtus and no client represents more than 20% of our portfolio.  
  
LEADERSHIP  
Virtus Partners was started in 2005 by its four partners who all remain actively engaged with the business on a daily basis. The name Virtus comes from ancient Rome and embodies concepts of excellence, character, and courage. It took courage for the four founding partners to step out on their own and start a new firm that would fulfill their vision of an independent company that combined cutting edge technology and exceptional customer service would better serve their customers in the structured credit industry. Partners represents the founding partners, but also the partnership between the founders and their employees and again with the firm’s clients.

-----------------------------------

Redport’s information assurance professionals provide proactive information systems defense by ensuring all elements of modern-day practices are enabled to provide confidentiality, integrity, authentication, availability and non-repudiation. Federal regulations have significantly increased the need for such standards and controls as well as today’s highly competitive marketplace; where emerging products and technologies require sound protection.  
  
Redport’s information assurance services are specialized to provide protection for federal and state government, Department of Defense, healthcare, and financial services data systems & infrastructures. It is those that have amassed confidential and personal information about their employees, customers, product lines, research & development initiatives, and finances that are at the greatest risk and remain the most viable targets of exploitation.  
  
Redport’s specialized services do not include a wide variety of information technology consulting services. We believe that our primary mission as well as our vision to exceed customer expectations in information assurance deserves our full attention. For that reason alone, we focus on nothing more than spearheading information assurance issues, and our spear is one of the sharpest in the industry. With more than 10 years of certified, hands-on, information assurance experience in protecting federal information systems, we offer a considerable complement to any organization.

About WonenBreburg
------------------

WonenBreburg zorgt voor huisvesting in de steden Breda en Tilburg en het gebied ertussen, Breburg. Wij bieden op korte en lange termijn zekerheid in wonen. Tevreden klanten die prettig wonen in onze buurten en wijken, daar gaat het ons om.  
  
Wij bieden woningen en diensten waar de klant behoefte aan heeft. Of we ontwikkelen maatschappelijk vastgoed voor klanten die extra zorg nodig hebben nu of in de toekomst. Een sterke vastgoedportefeuille met een hoogwaardige energetische kwaliteit vormt de basis van ons bestaan. We besteden bijzondere aandacht aan het huisvesten van mensen die dat moeilijker op eigen kracht redden (door een laag inkomen, dak- en thuislozen, een maatschappelijke, fysieke of verstandelijke beperking).  
  
Daarnaast hebben we speciale aandacht voor onze studenten en senioren. Wij maken ons in de buurten en wijken waar onze woningen liggen sterk voor deze wijken en voor de sociale ontwikkeling van de bewoners.

Our platform allows organizations to manage event logistics, track registrations, and communicate with attendees effectively. By integrating event management with brand asset management, organizations can ensure that all event materials align with their branding guidelines.

Reputation Management is a critical component of Capital ID's services, helping organizations monitor and enhance their online presence. Our tools enable businesses to track brand mentions, manage customer feedback, and respond to reviews in real-time. By proactively managing their reputation, organizations can build trust with their audience and maintain a positive brand image.

How does Capital ID support businesses in their marketing and communications efforts?

Capital ID provides a suite of tools designed to enhance enterprise marketing and communications. Our solutions include business process management (BPM), creative and production management, and publishing on demand. These tools help organizations streamline their marketing workflows, improve collaboration among teams, and ensure that all communications are professional and on-brand, ultimately driving better engagement with their target audience.

About Videojet Technologies
---------------------------

Videojet is a global leader in the development and manufacture of high-quality product identification equipment for coding and marking – including Continuous Ink Jet printers (CIJ), Laser Marking Systems, Thermal Transfer Overprinters (TTO), Case Coding, Print and Apply Labeling (LPA), Thermal Inkjet Printers (TIJ), Commercial Graphics and Addressing, CLARiSUITE™, and Code Assurance.  
  
Videojet products and services allow customers to apply variable data such as best-by date, production date, lot number, and operator information – as well as linear and 2D bar codes –to virtually any kind of product packaging, shipping container or pallet. Videojet work with vendors in packaged goods, pharmaceutical, and industrial goods industries, improving  
productivity, growing brands, and staying ahead of industry trends.  
  
Since its beginnings in the 1960s as a division of the A.B. Dick Company, Videojet has been innovating high-quality coding and marking equipment and supplies. Since joining the Danaher portfolio in 2002, Videojet has developed the new gold standard in track and trace coding solutions, won a Best Technological Innovation award at the 2016 Interphex Exhibitor Awards, and rolled out innovative developments like Long Life Core technology.

About Danielle Muhammad

Danielle Muhammad serves as the Vice President of Proposal Development at ICF, where she leverages over 25 years of extensive experience in directing Federal defense and civilian proposal initiatives. Her role is pivotal in leading the corporate Enterprise Proposal Center (EPC), a high-volume, strategic unit dedicated to crafting compelling responses to solicitations from Federal, state, and local agencies. Under her leadership, the EPC has successfully navigated complex, multi-million dollar proposals that not only align with aggressive business growth strategies but also adhere to stringent compliance standards.  
  
Danielle's expertise encompasses a wide array of skills, including management, proposal writing, and program management, making her a key asset in the competitive landscape of government contracting. She is a Certified Practitioner by the Association of Proposal Management Professionals (CP APMP), which underscores her commitment to excellence in proposal development and her deep understanding of industry best practices. Danielle's proficiency in conducting thorough color reviews and her adeptness in desktop publishing ensure that proposals are not only strategically sound but also visually compelling.  
  
Her academic background, including a Master’s Degree in Organizational Management, complements her practical experience, allowing her to effectively lead diverse teams of proposal professionals and specialists. Danielle's strategic vision and hands-on approach have been instrumental in enhancing ICF’s proposal capabilities, driving successful outcomes, and fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation within the organization. As she continues to spearhead key projects, Danielle remains focused on delivering high-impact proposals that meet the evolving needs of clients in the defense sector and beyond.

As the Senior Vice President of International Sales at FloQast, Adam Zoucha plays a pivotal role in transforming the way companies manage their monthly close processes across global markets. With a CPA certification and dual US/British citizenship, Adam brings a unique perspective to the international landscape, allowing him to navigate diverse regulatory environments and cultural nuances effectively. His leadership is instrumental in driving client satisfaction, new business acquisition, and client retention in regions outside of North America, particularly in EMEA and ANZ.  
  
Adam's expertise in accounting and finance, combined with his extensive experience in business development and start-ups, enables him to identify and capitalize on growth opportunities in emerging markets. He is currently spearheading key projects aimed at enhancing FloQast's presence and operational efficiency in these regions, ensuring that clients can close their books faster and with greater accuracy, ultimately reducing the hassle associated with financial reporting.  
  
In addition to his strategic oversight, Adam is a passionate advocate for leveraging technology to streamline accounting processes. His proficiency in tools like QuickBooks and Microsoft Excel, coupled with his public speaking skills, allows him to effectively communicate the value of FloQast’s solutions to potential clients and stakeholders. About Instinet
--------------

When Instinet gave birth to electronic trading in 1969, we were a small tech-focused start-up with a simple point of view: technology can bring great efficiency to the financial markets. No one had coined the term “fintech” yet, but that’s exactly what we were. It’s been our mission to remain at the forefront of advancements that shape the financial markets ever since.  
  
Today, as a part of The Nomura Group, Instinet’s global agency model provides services that span the entire investment life cycle. Our goal is to help our institutional clients create, preserve, and capture alpha in a changing world.  
  
We operate with a “client-first” approach—one that’s founded on robust and adaptive technology and has been enhanced by decades of experience fine-tuning our capabilities to a dynamic marketplace and the ever-evolving objectives of our clients.  
  
Instinet offers the institutional investment community a suite of tailorable solutions, including unique market insights and commentary, full-service trading desks, advanced algorithmic trading strategies, access to unique and specialized liquidity via our array of crossing pools, and a complement of award-winning workflow solutions. All engineered to help our clients efficiently manage their investment process, their way.

About By Miles
--------------

At By Miles, we are on a mission to make driving fairer and we think it’s time that car insurance was done differently for low mileage drivers.  
  
Offering a fairer kind of car insurance since 2018, By Miles is the UK's leading pay-by-mile car insurance provider, making car insurance more cost-effective and easier to manage for people who drive less.  
  
By Miles was voted UK's best car insurance provider & best insurance app at the Insurance Choice Awards 2020 and 2019.  
  
Our people are at the heart of what drives our business. So, it's not only our mission to make driving fairer but to be a fairer kind of employer too.  
  
How do we do this? We start with what we believe in, our Virtues.  
  
These are the things that really matter to us. We call them ‘virtues’ rather than ‘values' because they’re not just aspirational words, but things we already do and have committed to keep doing. We decided on these virtues as a whole company, so there’s no corporate waffle, just a basic set of shared beliefs that guide us in everything we do.  
  
Respect.  
We challenge with kindness, making sure everyone feels safe and included. We support each other.  
  
Fairness.  
We own up, we don’t blame. We’re humble enough to take feedback on board, and respectful enough to give it. The next big idea could come from anywhere, so everyone’s opinion matters.  
  
Growth.  
We take time to learn so that we can improve ourselves, our colleagues and our products. We’re not afraid to make mistakes if it gives us the opportunity to grow.  
  
Efficiency.  
We consider before we start, whether that’s interrogating details to save confusion down the line, or getting help from others.. We make decisions using data, not opinions, and we use our time wisely, always staying focused on the end goal.  
  
Ambition.  
We’re clear in our vision. We’re never afraid to challenge the status quo if it will help us make things better.  
  
Check out our jobs & life tabs (above) to find out more about working at By Miles.

What is By Miles and how does it differ from traditional car insurance?

By Miles is an innovative car insurance provider that focuses on low mileage drivers. Unlike traditional car insurance, which typically charges a flat rate regardless of how much you drive, By Miles offers a pay-per-mile insurance model. This means that you only pay for the miles you actually drive, making it a fairer option for those who use their cars infrequently. Additionally, By Miles utilizes telematics technology to track your mileage and driving behavior, ensuring that you receive a personalized insurance experience.

How does the pay-per-mile insurance model work?

With By Miles, you pay a fixed annual premium for your insurance coverage, which covers you for the year. On top of that, you pay a small fee for each mile you drive. This model is particularly beneficial for low mileage drivers, as it allows them to save money compared to traditional insurance plans that charge a flat rate. To track your mileage, you can use the By Miles mobile app or a telematics device, which records your trips and calculates your total mileage for billing.

What types of vehicles are eligible for By Miles insurance?

By Miles insurance is available for a wide range of vehicles, including personal cars, vans, and electric vehicles. However, there are some restrictions based on the vehicle's age, value, and type. To ensure your vehicle is eligible, you can visit the By Miles website or contact their customer support team for specific guidelines regarding your vehicle.

What features does the By Miles mobile app offer?

The By Miles mobile app is designed to enhance your insurance experience by providing real-time tracking of your mileage and driving behavior. Key features include trip logging, mileage tracking, and access to your insurance policy details. Additionally, the app allows you to manage your payments, view your driving statistics, and receive personalized tips to improve your driving habits, ultimately helping you save on your insurance costs.

How does By Miles ensure customer support and assistance?

By Miles is committed to providing excellent customer support through various channels. Customers can reach out for assistance via email, phone, or through the mobile app. The support team is knowledgeable about the services offered and is ready to help with any inquiries related to your policy, claims, or general questions about the pay-per-mile insurance model. Additionally, the By Miles website features a comprehensive FAQ section and resources to help customers navigate their insurance needs.

Is By Miles insurance suitable for business use or commercial vehicles?

By Miles primarily focuses on personal car insurance for low mileage drivers. While their model is designed for individual use, they do not currently offer specific coverage for business use or commercial vehicles. If you are looking for insurance for a business or commercial vehicle, it is advisable to explore other insurance providers that specialize in commercial coverage.

...moving people, data and goods...  
Imtech Traffic & Infra is a leading player in the traffic and specialised parts of the infrastructure markets; delivering technology-based products, systems and services which enable the effective and efficient movement of people, data and goods.  
  
Solving problems  
Imtech’s products, systems and services solve problems in road and rail transport, public lighting, communications, high voltage and infrastructure in urban, rural and inter-urban environments; delivering benefit to end users such as the travelling public, as well as achieving the goals of public and private transport operators and authorities.  
  
Added value  
With over 2,000 professionals working with Clients in The Netherlands, Belgium, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Sweden, Finland, Denmark, Poland and other countries worldwide, Imtech delivers added value through the combination of consultancy, design, development, installation and maintenance of the technologies and infrastructure that satisfy transport and communications challenges.  
  
Experience  
Our credibility comes from the development and delivery of our broad product portfolio, coupled with a strong track record in the delivery of integrated systems. We are driven by our determination to help people travel safely and effectively whilst respecting the environment. Our experienced and expert teams have a unique combination of product, systems and sector knowledge which we apply to challenges surrounding journey time reliability, the management of congestion and traffic flow, the integration of infrastructure networks, and the need for innovative technologies supported by reliable and quality services.

About U.S. Superyacht Association
---------------------------------

Working to promote the superyacht industry of the United States and to serve as its voice.  
  
Mission  
The USSA works to advance the U. S. superyacht industry as a whole and serves as a coordinated advocate on major issues affecting the industry.  
  
Company Overview  
What began as a small group of South Florida superyacht businesses banding together to market to the Superyacht Industry at the St Maarten Boat Show has now become the first U.S. based trade association dealing exclusively with the superyacht industry, the U.S. Superyacht Association (“USSA”).  
  
“It was long overdue for this country,” says the group’s Chair Tim Davey of ISS Global Marine Travel. “By most statistics, the vast majority of superyacht owners are American and the U.S. is home to some of the largest and most prestigious builders in the world.”  
  
Not unlike other such trade associations in the UK, Australia and Italy, the USSA’s mission is, “To Promote the Superyacht Industry of the United States and to serve as its voice.”  
  
“Initially we will be focusing on helping our members market themselves all over the world,” says one of the USSA’s founders, David Reed who published The Triton, “Ultimately, we see the USSA becoming a critical mass to address strategic issues that affect the growth of the U.S. Superyacht industry.”

About Green Network UK Plc
--------------------------

GREEN NETWORK UK PLC  
  
The core business of Green Network UK plc is the management of electricity and natural gas flows associated with Green Network Group’s activities.  
  
In 2018, the company carried out physical and financial optimisation of over 9 TWh of electricity and 400 mcm of natural gas of the Group’s sales in Italy and around 1 TWh of electricity and 150 mcm of natural gas of sales in the United Kingdom.  
  
The company’s trading capabilities were initially developed for the Italian territory and have now expanded to most of Europe’s electricity and gas wholesale markets. Today our focus is the continued consolidation of trading, optimisation and risk management for the physical and financial activities of the Group in Italy and the UK, as well as the management of the virtual interconnector flows in Germany.  
  
We are present on the European Energy Exchange/ PEGAS and have OTC market access arrangements with major international utilities and banks.

Genesys Spine is dedicated to advancing spinal surgery through research and development of innovative technologies. His expertise in full-cycle recruiting and strategic partnerships allows him to leverage business intelligence effectively, ensuring that the right talent is sourced to drive the company's mission of connecting people to the experiences they value.  
  
Key projects under Fabien's leadership include the implementation of advanced sourcing strategies that utilize data-driven insights to enhance recruitment efficiency and candidate engagement. He is also focused on fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace, recognizing that a variety of perspectives is crucial for innovation in the tech sector. Through his leadership and vision, Fabien is not only building a strong talent pipeline but also contributing to the broader goal of making autonomous vehicles a safe and accessible reality for everyone.

About LBJ Express
-----------------

LBJ Infrastructure Group (LBJIG) was awarded a 52-year contract to design, build, operate and maintain the LBJ Express project, a $2.7 billion, 13.3-mile highway in Dallas, Texas. The corridor spans along I-635/LBJ Freeway and is one of the most innovative, congestion-management projects in North Texas. Construction began in 2011 and was completed in 2015.  
  
The new highway includes redesigned, general highway lanes and fully-optimized frontage roads. As these were being rebuilt, four to six tolled express lanes (known as the LBJ TEXpress Lanes) were added in the middle of I-635, from Luna Road to Greenville Avenue. Since completion, the LBJ Express has doubled in capacity, spanning across two municipalities in Dallas County.  
  
At LBJ Infrastructure Group, we work to provide congestion-management solutions to North Texas drivers. With the addition of the LBJ TEXpress Lanes, we offer drivers a choice in their daily commutes. With more than 500,000 trips per day on the LBJ Express project alone, it is imperative to offer a product that enables drivers to maintain a more predictable rate of speed.  
  
The consortium which makes up LBJ Infrastructure Group is world leaders in transportation infrastructure development. These include Cintra, Meridiam and APG. Out of these, the lead firm in the consortium is Cintra.  
  
Mission: Why? We improve the future by developing and operating sustainable infrastructure and cities.  
How? Committed to the highest level of operational excellence and innovation.  
What? We create value for Cintra and for our customers, investors, and employees.  
  
Five values held by LBJIG and Cintra and its employees:  
• Innovation, progress, transformation, inspiration  
• Excellence, efficiency, results  
• Respect, care, protection  
• Collaboration, team work, cooperation  
• Integrity, ethics, transparency  
  
LBJ Infrastructure Group is accredited by the Better Business Bureau.

What is the LBJ Express project and what does it entail?

The LBJ Express project is a major infrastructure initiative in Dallas, Texas, involving the design, construction, operation, and maintenance of a 13.3-mile highway corridor. Awarded to the LBJ Infrastructure Group (LBJIG) under a 52-year contract, the project aims to enhance traffic flow and improve connectivity in the region. The $2.7 billion investment includes the addition of express lanes, upgrades to existing roadways, and the implementation of advanced traffic management systems.

How does LBJ Express improve traffic conditions in Dallas?

LBJ Express improves traffic conditions by introducing managed express lanes that allow for faster travel times during peak hours. These lanes are designed to reduce congestion by providing drivers with a reliable option for quicker commutes. Additionally, the project incorporates modern traffic management technologies that optimize traffic flow and enhance safety on the highway.

What types of vehicles are allowed to use the express lanes?

The express lanes on the LBJ Express corridor are open to all types of vehicles, including passenger cars, trucks, and buses. However, there may be specific toll rates applicable based on vehicle type and occupancy. Carpooling options may also be available, allowing eligible vehicles to use the express lanes at reduced or no toll rates during certain hours.

What are the benefits of using the LBJ Express lanes?

Using the LBJ Express lanes offers several benefits, including reduced travel times, less congestion, and improved reliability for commuters. The express lanes are designed to provide a consistent speed of travel, which can significantly decrease the time spent in traffic. Additionally, the toll revenue generated from these lanes is reinvested into maintaining and improving the highway infrastructure.

How can I pay for tolls on the LBJ Express lanes?

Tolls for the LBJ Express lanes can be paid through various methods, including electronic toll collection via a TxTag, EZ TAG, or TollTag. Drivers can also pay with a credit or debit card at designated toll booths. It is recommended to register for a toll tag to ensure seamless travel and potentially lower toll rates.

What maintenance services does LBJIG provide for the LBJ Express project?

LBJ Infrastructure Group is responsible for the ongoing maintenance and operation of the LBJ Express project. This includes regular inspections, repairs, and upgrades to ensure the safety and efficiency of the highway. Maintenance services also encompass roadway cleaning, landscaping, and the upkeep of traffic management systems to provide a safe and pleasant driving experience for all users.

About Pilgrims
--------------

Pilgrims is about personal transformation and stands for creating possibilities. so that the professionals we coach go beyond the norm of traditional English Teaching Methods and access skills and language far beyond their expectations.  
  
Based in historic Canterbury, our unique open-plan training space provides a learning environment that is real and reflects the real professional world instead of the of synthetic environment of traditional classrooms.  
  
We don't use books and our coaches don't plan lessons. This is because real progress in language and confidence comes from spontaneity and from you the participant being at the centre of everything and not a teacher's pre-conceived ideas of what the lessons should be.  
  
Every part of your Pilgrims experience is designed so that you feel comfortable, confident and concentrate fully on your own learning. At Pilgrims we teach people not methods. Our customer feedback is extraordinarily high. You work in small groups always with 2 trainers present. As a passionate advocate for customer-centric product development, Sanjay Angadi continues to shape the future of enterprise software at Ansys, ensuring that clients are well-equipped to thrive in an increasingly digital landscape.

What types of businesses can benefit from REV Solutions' eCommerce services?

REV Solutions, Inc. specializes in providing eCommerce solutions for a wide range of businesses, including retailers, manufacturers, and suppliers. Whether you are a small business looking to expand online or a large enterprise needing a robust eCommerce platform, our services are tailored to meet your specific needs. We focus on both B2B and B2C markets, ensuring that our clients can effectively reach their target audiences.

What eCommerce platforms does REV Solutions implement?

REV Solutions implements two leading eCommerce platforms: Oracle ATG and Demandware (now known as Salesforce Commerce Cloud). Oracle ATG is a licensed software solution that offers extensive customization and scalability, making it ideal for larger enterprises. Demandware is a SaaS solution that provides a flexible, cloud-based platform perfect for businesses looking for quick deployment and ease of use. Our team will help you choose the best solution based on your business requirements.

How does REV Solutions ensure a successful eCommerce implementation?

At REV Solutions, we follow a structured implementation process that includes thorough planning, design, development, and testing. Our team of experts collaborates closely with clients to understand their unique needs and objectives. We also provide ongoing support and training to ensure that your team is equipped to manage the platform effectively post-launch. Our goal is to deliver a seamless eCommerce experience that drives sales and enhances customer satisfaction.

Can REV Solutions assist with international eCommerce operations?

Yes, REV Solutions has experience in supporting international eCommerce operations, including businesses looking to expand into markets like India and beyond. We understand the complexities of cross-border trade, including currency conversion, taxation, and compliance with local regulations. Our solutions are designed to help businesses navigate these challenges and effectively reach global customers.

What industries does REV Solutions serve?

REV Solutions serves a diverse range of industries, including retail, manufacturing, and wholesale distribution. Our expertise in eCommerce allows us to cater to various sectors, ensuring that we can provide tailored solutions that meet the specific demands of each industry. Whether you are in fashion, electronics, or consumer goods, our team is equipped to help you succeed in the online marketplace.

What kind of support does REV Solutions offer after implementation?

After the implementation of your eCommerce platform, REV Solutions offers comprehensive support services, including technical assistance, performance monitoring, and ongoing training. Our dedicated support team is available to address any issues that may arise and to provide guidance on optimizing your eCommerce operations. We believe in building long-term partnerships with our clients and are committed to helping you achieve sustained success in your online business.

About Nitta Corporation of America

Nitta Corporation of America supplies leading-edge industrial belting to all industry segments.  
  
As the U.S. arm of Japan’s Nitta Corporation, NCA is responsible for serving customers in the Western Hemisphere. Nitta’s worldwide goal is to offer products of unmatched quality and performance so that customers can achieve optimum production, efficiency and lowest operating costs.  
  
From its manufacturing facility in Suwanee, Georgia, NCA manufactures the PolyBelt series of flat nylon power transmission belting and Aramid CF finger spliceable power transmission belts. PolySprint finger spliceable power transmission belts, Super Endless power transmission belting and high-tech conveyor belting are manufactured in various plants around the world and stocked and fabricated in Georgia for immediate shipment.

About Centralpoint.nl
---------------------

Over Centralpoint.nl  
Alles rondom uw ICT eenvoudig online bestellen en snel in huis. Een ongekend grote keuze en een scherpe prijs. En dat alles bij een betrouwbare webwinkel, die u ook nog eens graag adviseert over de perfecte zakelijke ICT-oplossing. Onrealistisch? Nee, hoor. Wij zijn Centralpoint.nl, aangenaam.  
  
Centralpoint.nl is ISO 9001 en 14001 gecertificeerd en bestaat sinds 2001. Sindsdien zijn we uitgegroeid tot de grootste en beste zakelijke ICT-leverancier van Nederland met een jaaromzet van ruim 120 miljoen euro. Wij zien het als onze missie om aan al uw ICT-wensen tegemoet te komen. Dat betekent dat u werkelijk elk product bij ons kunt bestellen. En dan bedoelen we ook echt alles. Van populaire smartphones of tablets tot de betrouwbaarste servers of storage-oplossingen. En van eenvoudige netwerkkabels tot de nieuwste laptops of de kleinste printeraccessoires. Uiteraard altijd in de hoeveelheid die uw organisatie nodig heeft. En binnen de leveringstermijn die u wenst.  
  
We mind your business  
We begrijpen echter ook dat u niet altijd exact weet wat voor u de perfecte ICT-oplossing is. Daarom bieden we u – naast onze webwinkel – Centralpoint Business Solutions. Hier heeft u een eigen accountmanager die zich in uw organisatie verdiept. Welke eisen stelt u aan uw kantoorautomatisering? Op welke manier is uw datacenter ingericht? Hoe gaat u om met uw complexe ICT-infrastructuur? En belangrijker nog: welke producten en diensten voldoen aan uw eisen? Wij adviseren u graag. U krijgt daarbij toegang tot een eigen online portal, waarop u altijd inzicht heeft in uw bestellingen, offertes, leveringen en facturen. Centralpoint Business Solutions bedient met name organisaties met honderd medewerkers of meer.  
  
Bij Centralpoint.nl winkelt u veilig en vertrouwd. Centralpoint.nl is o.a. lid van Thuiswinkel Waarborg en Thuiswinkel Zakelijk en draagt maximaal zorg voor een optimale beveiliging van uw gegevens.

About Johnson Plastics
----------------------

Johnson Plastics Plus, headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota, has been a leading supplier to the engraving and sign making industry since 1970. We built our business on the belief that a strong customer focus is as important to the business as the products that are sold.  
  
In 2017, Johnson Plastics was rebranded as Johnson Plastics Plus after integrating with Bur-Lane, Inc., a manufacturer and distributor of engraving plastic and identification accessories and supplies. A short time later, LaserBits, a wholesaler of laser materials and training, also joined our Johnson Plastics Plus family, and we are now pleased to offer LaserBits’ entire product range.  
  
Johnson Plastics is always prepared to serve our national customer base with nine conveniently located branch offices and warehouses -- California, Texas, Ohio, Georgia, Illinois, Oklahoma, Arizona, Pennsylvania, and New York. We are also proud to feature the Guaranteed In-Stock program, which ensures that our most popular items will always be available for our customers.  
  
Originally one of the charter distributors of Rowmark engraving materials, Johnson Plastics was acquired by Rowmark, LLC in 2015 in order to better serve the engraving industry.  
  
Johnson Plastics Plus entered the sublimation arena in 2002. Partnering with Unisub, Sawgrass, Vapor Apparel, Geo Knight and several other vendors, we have become a dominant force in sublimation.  
  
Knowledgeable and friendly customer service representatives are eager to take your order or answer questions about our products. Johnson Plastics Plus’ Customer Service Representatives have an average of 10 years of experience and have developed lasting relationships with our customers to better serve your needs. Online ordering is available 24/7. Product is normally shipped within 24 hours of receipt of your order. Our Johnson Plastics Plus commitment to serving the needs of the engraving, sublimation and sign making customers remains our primary focus.

We conduct applied research on high-performance ceramics. The institute‘s three sites in Dresden and Hermsdorf (Thuringia), Germany, collectively represent Europe‘s largest R&D institute dedicated to the study of ceramics.  
  
Profound know-how in materials sciences, manufacturing technologies, systems integration as well as materials and process analysis positions Fraunhofer IKTS to link different technological worlds for developing customized solutions. These solutions are used in the fields of mechanical and automotive engineering, energy, environmental and process engineering, materials and process analysis, materials and processes, bio- and medical technology, optics as well as electronics and microsystems.    
Fraunhofer IKTS as a technology leader and innovation driver contributes to the quality assurance of products and manufacturing technologies. For customers, our offers generate economic advantages by guaranteed quality, optimum yield and short innovation cycles.

It is widely recognized for its women’s services program, including water births, and the hospital’s weight‐loss program is designated as a Metabolic and Bariatric Surgery Accreditation and Quality Improvement Program (MBSAQIP). WellStar Atlanta Medical Center provides sports medicine coverage to Atlanta Public Schools student athletes.

Yunhong is also the creator of UDT (UDP-based Data Transfer Protocol) and Sector/Sphere, which are open-source projects that have garnered attention for their innovative approaches to data transfer and storage. What services does TerraPass offer for carbon offsetting?

TerraPass provides a variety of carbon offset programs that allow individuals and businesses to compensate for their carbon emissions. These programs include renewable energy projects, methane capture initiatives, and reforestation efforts. By purchasing carbon offsets, customers can support projects that reduce greenhouse gas emissions equivalent to their own carbon footprint.

How can I calculate my carbon footprint using TerraPass?

TerraPass offers an easy-to-use carbon footprint calculator on their website. Users can input data related to their energy consumption, transportation habits, and waste production. The calculator then estimates the total carbon emissions generated by these activities, allowing individuals and businesses to understand their environmental impact and explore options for offsetting their emissions.

What types of industries does TerraPass support with its sustainability solutions?

TerraPass supports a wide range of industries, including transportation, manufacturing, agriculture, and retail. Their sustainability solutions are tailored to meet the unique needs of each sector, helping organizations implement effective carbon reduction strategies, improve energy efficiency, and develop comprehensive sustainability plans.

Can TerraPass help my business develop a sustainability strategy?

Yes, TerraPass offers consulting services to help businesses create and implement effective sustainability strategies. Their team of experts works closely with organizations to assess current practices, identify areas for improvement, and develop actionable plans that align with corporate goals while reducing environmental impact.

What are the benefits of participating in a carbon offset program?

Participating in a carbon offset program offers several benefits, including the ability to neutralize your carbon footprint, enhance your brand's reputation by demonstrating environmental responsibility, and contribute to meaningful projects that combat climate change. Additionally, businesses may find that offsetting emissions can help meet regulatory requirements and improve stakeholder relations.

How does TerraPass ensure the quality and effectiveness of its carbon offset projects?

TerraPass is committed to transparency and quality in its carbon offset projects. They partner with verified projects that meet rigorous standards set by recognized organizations, such as the Verified Carbon Standard (VCS) and the Climate Action Reserve (CAR). Each project undergoes thorough monitoring and verification to ensure that it delivers real, measurable, and additional emissions reductions.

Wellinks is a COPD-focused digital health company fueled by a mission to empower people in their pursuit to breathe freely. Wellinks’ lead asset is a digitally enabled and outcomes-driven holistic virtual care management solution for COPD, with a focus on reinventing respiratory care. Key projects under her guidance include the development of innovative features that enhance user experience and safety, as well as initiatives aimed at building a robust network of local childcare providers. About Klaas Buist

Klaas Buist is a seasoned international executive with a robust track record in ecommerce and technology, currently serving as the Director of Ecommerce at Vlisco Netherlands. With over 25 years of experience spanning the premium fashion, food, and ICT industries, Klaas has honed his expertise in global business transformation and strategic planning. His leadership has been pivotal in driving significant digital growth at Vlisco, where he has successfully managed the online P&L and achieved remarkable milestones, including doubling the online sales over the past two years and enhancing operating profit by an impressive 75%.  
  
A key component of Klaas's strategy has been the implementation of an AI-driven Customer Data Platform, which has resulted in a staggering 500% increase in the consumer database in just one year. This data-centric approach has allowed for optimized digital marketing investments, ensuring that Vlisco remains at the forefront of the competitive fashion landscape. Additionally, Klaas has spearheaded the transition to the Shopify platform, streamlining operations and enhancing the overall customer experience.  
  
As a member of the Executive Board, Klaas is not only focused on driving change within Vlisco but also on fostering a culture of innovation and agility. His skills in project management, business intelligence, and information management are instrumental in navigating the complexities of the ecommerce landscape. With a keen eye for integration and master data management, Klaas is dedicated to leveraging technology to create sustainable growth and deliver exceptional value to customers. His vision for Vlisco is clear: to redefine the online shopping experience while solidifying the brand's position as a leader in the premium fashion sector.

Best Money Moves is a mobile-first service designed to help people measure their financial stress and then dial it down in order to gain control of their financial lives. Our service is sold to employers who then offer it to their employees as a free employee benefit.  
  
Did you know that 63 percent of employees don’t have $500 in a savings account, more than 70 percent have less than $15,000 saved for retirement and nearly 50 percent don’t opt-in to their employer’s 401(k) contributions?  
  
We don’t try to sell anything to your employees. There are no ads and no hidden tricks. Our only goal is to help people make smarter moves with their money. We do this by providing award-winning information, easy-to-use tools, a points-based reward system and a unique content-mapping structure that solves financial problems quickly and easily.  
  
80 percent of your employees are suffering from moderate or severe financial stress and it has become overwhelming. As an employer, this shouldn’t be your problem. But it is. Financially stressed employees miss more work and are less focused, engaged and productive than non-financially stressed colleagues, with much higher rates of turnover.  
  
It doesn’t have to be this way. We’re a different sort of financial wellness program.  
  
Best Money Moves allows people to measure their levels of financial stress in up to 15 categories. The system then recommends the most relevant information, tools and calculators in order to provide necessary information they need to recognize and solve your employees’ pain points. There will never be a thinly-veiled sales pitch for other products and services they likely can’t afford.  
  
Don’t forget: fewer financially-stressed employees translates into a happier, healthier and more productive workforce. Let us help your employees find their Best Money Moves, today.

What type of information can I find on Wikileaf regarding cannabis strains?

Wikileaf provides comprehensive information on a wide variety of cannabis strains, including detailed descriptions, effects, flavors, and medical uses. Users can explore strain ratings, user reviews, and comparisons to help them make informed decisions about which strains may best suit their needs.

Does Wikileaf offer any educational resources for cannabis cultivation?

Yes, Wikileaf offers a range of educational resources for both novice and experienced cultivators. This includes guides on growing techniques, tips for indoor and outdoor cultivation, pest management, and information on the best practices for harvesting and curing cannabis plants.

How does Wikileaf support the cannabis industry?

Wikileaf supports the cannabis industry through its extensive network and marketing solutions. By providing a platform for cannabis businesses to connect with consumers, Wikileaf helps promote brands, products, and services. Additionally, the site features industry news and insights that keep users informed about trends and developments in the cannabis market.

Can I find information on medical marijuana advocacy and education on Wikileaf?

Absolutely! Wikileaf is committed to medical marijuana advocacy and education. The platform offers resources that educate users about the benefits and uses of medical marijuana, including information on various conditions that may be treated with cannabis, legal considerations, and patient testimonials.

Is there a community aspect to Wikileaf where users can share experiences and knowledge?

Yes, Wikileaf fosters a community of cannabis enthusiasts where users can share their experiences, reviews, and knowledge. The platform encourages interaction through user-generated content, allowing individuals to connect and learn from one another while discussing strains, cultivation techniques, and industry news.

How can I stay updated on the latest cannabis industry news through Wikileaf?

Wikileaf features a dedicated news section that provides the latest updates and articles related to the cannabis industry. Users can subscribe to newsletters or follow Wikileaf on social media platforms to receive real-time updates on trends, legislation, and other important developments in the cannabis space.
