About Shoe Sensation, Inc.
--------------------------

We LOVE Shoes!!! Our mission at Shoe Sensation, Inc. is to provide quality and brand name footwear for the entire family. From toddlers to seniors, our large selection of shoes has something for everyone as the typical Shoe Sensation will showcase over 10,000 pairs of the latest styles. We have over 200 retail location in 19 states.  
  
National brands such as Skechers, Clarks, Crocs, and Easy Street for women are featured as well as an extensive collection of junior shoes from Rocket Dog, Fergalicious, Jellypop, Sperry, Skechers and Bearpaw. Children’s shoes are available in popular brands including Skechers and Nike. Prominent men’s brands include Dockers, Dr. Martens, Timberland, Lugz and Durango. A wide range of athletic shoes – from Under Armour, New Balance, Adidas, Asics, Puma and others, as well as the latest lifestyle brands like Converse and Vans – are also available at Shoe Sensation, Inc. Our Work and Safety styles include brands such as CAT, Timberland Pro, Wolverine, Skechers Work and more!  
  
In addition to our sensational product offering, we strive to be good stewards in our communities and to help out whenever possible. It means a great deal to us to make a difference in the towns where we live. Please, visit the Shoe Sensation Website to read about some of the events we have participated in over the years. Feel free to contact us for an event idea of your own!  
  
We hire our management straight from the local community purposefully to embed our stores in local events and to become part of your community. At Shoe Sensation, Inc. our emphasis is on connecting with our hometowns, and we are always looking for new talent to add to our team. Check out our career opportunities web site, to see if we have something for you! https://www.shoesensation.com/careers

As the Managing Director of TMP Solutions (Traffic Management Products Ltd), Suzanne Day brings a wealth of expertise and leadership to the forefront of the fluid power and traffic management sectors. One of Suzanne's key projects includes the continuous evolution of the Flecta, the first retroreflective traffic bollard introduced nearly twenty years ago. This groundbreaking product set a new standard in traffic management, and under her guidance, TMP Solutions has enhanced its features to include a diverse range of installation options, customizable graphics, and energy-efficient illumination. Suzanne’s commitment to customer feedback has led to the development of a comprehensive product range that meets the dynamic needs of modern infrastructure.  
  
Her strategic vision encompasses a robust marketing strategy and effective business planning, ensuring that TMP Solutions remains at the cutting edge of industry trends. Suzanne's expertise in negotiation and sales operations has been pivotal in forging strong partnerships and expanding market reach. Furthermore, her adeptness in change management and operations management has enabled the company to navigate the complexities of manufacturing while maintaining high-quality standards. As a leader, Suzanne Day exemplifies the essence of British engineering, driving TMP Solutions towards a future of innovation and safety in traffic management.

About RODE Architects Inc.
--------------------------

RODE Architects Inc. is a collaborative design team led by its two Principals and owners, Eric J. Robinson and Kevin S. Deabler. Located in Boston, Massachusetts and founded in 2005, RODE’s approach to design follows an iterative process that molds its client’s ideas, experiences and goals into spaces that exceed expectations. The combined, diverse experience of the Principals allows RODE to provide a far-reaching range of design services, from master planning and feasibility surveys to project management and innovative architectural solutions. Clients have included developers, private individuals, business owners and educational institutions.  
  
Principals Eric and Kevin are each LEED Accredited Professionals and registered architects with a working relationship that spans nearly 20 years, back to their undergraduate studies in design and architecture. Today, RODE is the professional fermentation of their unique skills and capabilities. Their flexible process, combined with an inherent, tight collaboration with their clients, has allowed them to create a design portfolio spanning from projects such as residential additions, housing developments and educational environments.

At Honda Aircraft Company, we are enhancing people’s lives through innovative technology in aviation with the betterment of humankind in mind. For over six decades, Honda has been a global symbol for intelligent and efficient technologies that have contributed to continual human progress and have radically advanced personal mobility worldwide. Honda’s commitment to taking personal mobility skyward to support the change-makers of tomorrow gave birth to Honda Aircraft Company. We are more than creators of technologically advanced aircraft — we are the bridge between people and the connection to the world around us.  
  
As the only established automobile company to successfully enter the aviation market with type certification, we are pioneers in challenging conventional notions in this industry. We use our newcomer status to our advantage by finding innovative solutions to transform business aviation and make it more efficient and accessible. As Honda’s most novel division, we embody a start-up company culture of embracing creativity and diversity of thought, as well as our President and CEO Hideto Yamasaki’s vision of revolutionizing the aviation industry with imagination and an unwavering spirit of innovation. Today, our dynamic team is taking on the modern challenges of mobility and creating aircraft at the intersection of art and engineering.  
  
For the past five consecutive years, the HondaJet has defied all odds as an industry newcomer and has achieved the coveted No. 1 delivery status in its class. This achievement was only possible due to our Honda culture of always striving to exceed expectations and thinking outside the box. Our goal is to continue creating the most cutting-edge and low-emission technologies for our aircraft and this can only be accomplished with passionate, big-hearted dreamers. Come join our diverse team of visionaries to reimagine and develop the future of mobility in the skies.

What services does GovPilot offer to local governments?

GovPilot provides a comprehensive suite of services designed to facilitate digital transformation for local governments. These services include SaaS solutions for data management, workflow automation, GIS mapping, and scheduling. Additionally, GovPilot offers tools for license issuance, public health management, and civic engagement, enabling local governments to streamline operations and enhance service delivery to their communities.

How does GovPilot support smart city initiatives?

GovPilot supports smart city initiatives by providing technology solutions that enhance data management and improve civic engagement. Through its GIS capabilities, local governments can visualize and analyze data to make informed decisions. The platform also enables real-time communication with citizens, allowing for better resource allocation and improved public services, which are essential components of smart city development.

Can GovPilot help with the management of government records?

Yes, GovPilot offers robust solutions for government record management. The platform allows local governments to digitize, store, and manage records efficiently, ensuring compliance with regulations and improving accessibility for both staff and citizens. This digital approach reduces the reliance on paper records, streamlining workflows and enhancing transparency in government operations.

What industries does GovPilot primarily serve?

GovPilot primarily serves local government entities across various industries, including public health, urban planning, and community development. Its solutions are tailored to meet the unique needs of municipalities, counties, and other local government organizations, helping them to improve operational efficiency and citizen engagement.

How does GovPilot facilitate workflow automation for local governments?

GovPilot facilitates workflow automation by providing customizable tools that allow local governments to automate repetitive tasks and processes. This includes automating permit applications, license renewals, and service requests. By streamlining these workflows, GovPilot helps reduce processing times, minimize errors, and free up staff to focus on more strategic initiatives.

Is GovPilot suitable for small local governments?

Absolutely! GovPilot is designed to be scalable and user-friendly, making it suitable for local governments of all sizes, including small municipalities. The platform offers flexible pricing options and a range of features that can be tailored to meet the specific needs and budget constraints of smaller governments, enabling them to benefit from digital transformation without overwhelming their resources.

MCLA is a thriving architectural lighting design firm founded in 1996 by Maureen Moran. As a full service lighting firm, MCLA collaborates with architects, designers and owners to create places for working, learning, visiting, conferencing and socializing.  
  
MCLA’s work spans the continental US and extends to Europe, Central and South America, Asia, and the Middle East. These projects range from exteriors and interiors, renovations and new construction, photometric studies, and lighting surveys for various market sectors:

• AutoCAD 2012 – computer-aided design and drafting  
• AGi32 – lighting calculations and daylight simulations  
• Revit – building information modeling  
  
MCLA is 100% woman-owned and certified as a CBE in Washington, D.C., MBE by Maryland Department of Transportation, SWaM by Virginia Department of Minority Business Enterprise, and nationally by Women’s Business Enterprise National Council (WBENC).

About Hampton Art
-----------------

Hampton Art was founded in 1980 by the Gallagher family. For over 20 years, the Gallagher's manufactured premium quality rubber stamps, clear stamps and stamping accessories featuring designer lines such as Diffusion, Art Warehouse, Studio G and many more.  
  
Hampton Art was acquired in 2007 by National Spinning in North Carolina. National Spinning continues the Hampton Art tradition of premium quality rubber and clear stamps while expanding the company's offerings of paper crafting and scrapbook products with new and exciting designer collections such as 7 Gypsies, Graphic 45, Ditto and more!  
  
Hampton Art proudly manufactures and distributes premium quality rubber stamps, clear stamps, paper products and inks.  
  
Hampton Art strives to provide new and innovative products meant to inspire creativity. With a unique collaboration of licensed designers, Hampton Arts design team, and a knowledgeable customer service staff, Hampton Art offers new and exciting stamp images and coordinating paper crafting products throughout the year.  
  
In an effort to provide unique and affordable products, Hampton Art also distributes a full line of value products for Studio G.

About Food Evolution
--------------------

The first company in Italy to produce meat analogues through a wet extrusion process! Our technology, originally developed from the best European Universities, has been further implemented by us and is able to replicate the exact TEXTURE of meat.  
After years of research and development, we managed to create a completely plant-based product with a clean label and with a limited number of selected natural ingredients only.  
The entire production process, from fiber creation to cryogenic freezing, takes only 12 minutes and thus guarantee spectacular level of health, safety and hygiene.  
The range of Food Evolution products includes chicken-flavored pieces, bacon-flavored cubes and beef-flavored stew with herbs suitable for everyone, from the most committed vegan to the authentic carnivores, passing through all Flexitarians.  
The entire line is a source of high protein content (22 to 24% ), gluten-free, low in fat and carbohydrates and with the same texture and the flavor of the meat itself!  
The products are available in 165 g retail format, 2 kg food service and 20 kg industry.  
All this seasoned with the unmistakable Italian taste!

About Robert Unanski

Robert Unanski is a seasoned Senior Technical Sales Engineer at Henkel Corporation, where he leverages over 20 years of extensive experience to drive sales growth and provide exceptional technical support across a diverse range of industries. Based in a home office, Robert expertly manages a multi-million dollar sales territory encompassing Arizona, New Mexico, and Nevada, focusing primarily on the renowned Loctite brand of industrial adhesives and sealants. His role is pivotal in delivering field sales engineering support and application assistance, catering to sectors such as defense, aerospace, alternative energy, medical devices, automotive, electronics, heavy-duty machinery, mining, and metal products.  
  
In his current position, Robert excels in territory sales management, where he employs his deep understanding of adhesive technologies to forge strong relationships with key accounts and distributors. His expertise in Industrial OEM and MRO businesses enables him to identify customer needs and provide tailored solutions that enhance operational efficiency and product performance. Notably, Robert has been instrumental in developing sales channels and driving market penetration for Henkel’s innovative adhesive solutions, particularly in high-stakes industries like defense technology and medical devices, where reliability and precision are paramount.  
  
Robert’s proficiency in sales engineering, combined with his technical acumen, allows him to effectively communicate complex product benefits to clients, ensuring they are well-informed and confident in their purchasing decisions. His commitment to customer satisfaction and his ability to navigate the intricacies of various industries make him a valuable asset to Henkel and a trusted partner for his clients. As he continues to expand his influence in the Southwestern United States, Robert remains dedicated to fostering growth and innovation within the adhesive market.

About Avon and Somerset Constabulary
------------------------------------

Our mission at Avon and Somerset Police is to serve, protect and respect our communities.  
  
We do this with the vision to deliver outstanding policing for everyone.  
Our people are caring, courageous, inclusive and are always seeking to learn and improve our services. These are the qualities we value most in our current employees and those we want to attract.  
  
We have more than 6,000 people in our organisation. As the seventh largest police force in England and Wales, we serve a population of more than 1.65 million, across a large and diverse area. And, while we have more than 3,000 police officers, PCSOs and special constables, you might be surprised to know they make up around half of our workforce.  
  
Thinking of working for us? We offer unique careers where you will be valued, inspired and feel rewarded. From accountants to police officers and from investigators to web developers, we have a wide range of roles where you can make a difference.  
  
We are also very proud to be an ENEI (Employers Network for Equality and Inclusion) award-winner, Stonewall accredited, and a Disability Confident employer with a National Equality Standard.  
  
While our HQ is in Portishead, we have stations and offices right across our beautiful force area in South Gloucestershire, Somerset and BaNES, including our cities of Bristol, Bath and Wells, as well as many flexible working options.  
  
To find out more about our current vacancies, visit: www.avonandsomerset.police.uk/recruitment

About HQ Eurocorps
------------------

Europe's strongest and rapidly deployable army corps headquarters  
  
A force for the European Union and NATO - preparing for EUTM Mali  
  
With its modular engagement plan the spectrum of possible missions for Eurocorps covers all types of operations: disaster relief, humanitarian aid, security assistance, low intensity conflicts, peace keeping, medium intensity conflicts, peace restoring and enforcing up to high intensity conflicts. The Eurocorps command posts are capable of commanding: advisory teams, training missions, multiple battalions, brigades, divisions and army corps level troops.  
These capacities are available for the security and defense needs of the European Union, NATO, the UN, the OSCE or the framework nations.  
Headquarters Eurocorps was founded in 1992 and declared operational in November 1995. The founding fathers intention was realized as Eurocorps was available for crisis response operations. The following years Eurocorps' presence at missions in Bosnia-Herzegovina, Kosovo and Afghanistan have proven the operational qualities of this multinational unit. NATO evaluated Eurocorps as an excellent headquarters capable of mastering difficult missions. The EUTM Mali mission starts 28 July 2015 for a duration of six months. All these missions make of Eurocorps one of the most deployed headquarters in Europe.  
The troop contribution nations are Eurocorps' framework nations. The contribution of the framework nations will always depend on the specific needs of the mission. The units foreseen under Eurocorps command are earmarked but stay in their respective country. However they train together with HQ Eurocorps. After a transfer of authority they can be placed under operational command in case of an engagement.

About United Grain Corporation (UGC)
------------------------------------

United Grain Corporation (UGC) is a bulk grain export company located in Vancouver, Washington USA. Formed in 1969, UGC quickly established itself as a premier wheat export company delivering high quality products to customers overseas and superior services to suppliers across the Pacific Northwest.  
  
The increase in world population coupled with the shift of food demand towards a more protein rich diet, propelled UGC to expand operations to include the handling of feed grains and oilseeds. In 2011 UGC embarked in a supply chain expansion to both inland and export terminals in order to accommodate an array of bulk product offerings: wheat, feed grains, and oilseeds.  
  
Today our Vancouver Export Terminal (VET) boasts the largest storage capacity on the US West Coast at 220,000 metric tons (8 million bushels) with an annual handling capacity of 5 million tons.

How does United Grain Corporation manage logistics for grain exports?

UGC employs a comprehensive logistics strategy to ensure efficient grain exports. This includes coordinating transportation from country terminals to the port, managing shipping schedules, and ensuring compliance with international shipping regulations. Their experienced logistics team works closely with carriers and port authorities to streamline the export process and minimize delays.

What risk management services does United Grain Corporation offer?

United Grain Corporation provides robust risk management services designed to help clients navigate the complexities of the grain market. United Grain Corporation serves a wide range of industries, including food production, animal feed, and biofuels. Powerco Federal Credit Union, headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, has been a trusted financial partner since its charter in 1935. With over $185 million in assets and a growing membership base of more than 21,000 individuals and their families, Powerco stands as one of the largest and fastest-growing credit unions in Georgia. As a member-focused, non-profit financial institution, Powerco prioritizes its members' needs, ensuring that they are treated as owners rather than just account numbers.  
  
Powerco offers a comprehensive range of financial services designed to empower its members. These include checking and savings accounts, personal loans, auto loans, mortgages, and credit cards, all tailored to meet the diverse needs of its members. The credit union is committed to providing competitive rates and low fees, making it an ideal choice for those looking to save and borrow effectively. Powerco’s dedication to member satisfaction is reflected in its array of free and low-fee products, ensuring that financial wellness is accessible to all.  
  
In addition to traditional banking services, Powerco embraces modern technology to enhance the member experience. Online banking, mobile apps, and digital payment options are available, allowing members to manage their finances conveniently and securely. Furthermore, all deposits at Powerco are federally insured by the National Credit Union Administration (NCUA), providing peace of mind with coverage up to $250,000 per depositor. With its strong community focus and commitment to financial education, Powerco Federal Credit Union is truly "the best place to save and borrow," making a positive impact in the lives of its members and the communities it serves.

About Opéra National de Bordeaux
--------------------------------

Institution culturelle incontournable et acteur économique majeur de Bordeaux et sa région, l’Opéra National de Bordeaux rassemble plus de 400 collaborateurs et 100 métiers nécessaires à la production, la diffusion et la transmission du spectacle vivant.  
  
Dirigé depuis janvier 2022 par Emmanuel Hondré, l’établissement présente sa programmation au Grand-Théâtre et à l’Auditorium de Bordeaux, mais également en tournées.  
  
« Nous souhaitons démontrer que l’art lyrique, chorégraphique et symphonique n’appartient pas au passé mais permet d’aborder les grands enjeux de notre société. Parce que je suis profondément convaincu que l’opéra se doit d’être le "miroir de notre monde" mais aussi le "miroir de notre temps", mon projet pour l’institution aura pour ambition d’en faire un Opéra citoyen, plus partagé et ouvert sur la ville, tout en préservant bien sûr notre exigence artistique. » - Emmanuel Hondré  
  
Partenaire naturel pour les entreprises du territoire, l’Opéra dispose d’une offre étoffée qui leur est destinée : formules entreprises clé en main, location d’espaces, club entreprises, mécénat, parrainage… Diverses possibilités de s’associer à une maison d’opéra renommée œuvrant pour l’intérêt général.

TALAS is a company committed to serving the fields of art, particularly art conservation, restoration and bookbinding.  
  
We continually strive to use our knowledge, innovation, and resources to provide the highest quality supplies and services to our customers. We believe our success is measured by the service we provide.  
  
Established in 1962 by Elaine and Herbert Haas, TALAS became the first company in the US to serve the museum and library community with hand bookbinding and conservation supplies.  
  
Today the Salik family continues to operate TALAS as a family run business, serving institutions, companies, and individuals around the world with the highest quality supplies and materials available. About Leonard Buildings & Truck Accessories
-------------------------------------------

Established in the Blue Ridge foothills of North Carolina in 1963, Leonard Buildings and Truck Accessories is a manufacturer and distributor whose product lines include storage buildings, cargo and utility trailers, truck covers and truck & van accessories, carports, playhouses, and animal structures. We serve our residential, commercial, fleet and government customers through our 59 factory outlet stores in the five-state region of North Carolina, South Carolina, Virginia, West Virginia and Tennessee.  
  
Seventy percent of our business last year resulted from repeat customers and referrals. We hear a lot of this: "I am here because when I was growing up my grandfather had a Leonard building in his backyard . . ." We take pride in serving folks as if they were our family.  
  
Leonard got into the truck cover business before fiberglass when they were made with wood and aluminum siding. Now we are the largest LEER cover dealer in the country and have sold and installed over a quarter of a million of them. This product line expanded and we now offer over 150,000 parts and have developed service centers designed for installing more technically demanding truck accessories like bed-liners, hitches, step bars, bull bars, winches, and lift kits. Most of our stores have a fully equipped spray booths with state of the art equipment. We made it our mission to find the best technicians, train them more, and keep them happy.

-----------------------------------------

About Tina Mariager

Tina Mariager is a dynamic professional currently serving as a Mediator for The Ambassador Sir John L. Loeb Jr. Danish Art Collection, where she plays a pivotal role in bridging the gap between art collectors and sellers. With a rich background in the performing arts, which began at the tender age of six in the "Næsbygård Trilogy" under the esteemed direction of Alice O. Fredericks, Tina has cultivated a profound understanding of the artistic landscape. This early experience instilled in her a strong foundation of professionalism and an appreciation for the intricate competencies required to elevate artistry in various forms.  
  
In her current role, Tina is actively engaged in the search for notable paintings by renowned Danish artists such as P.S. Krøyer, Otto Bache, and W. Hammershøi, among others. Her expertise in arts administration and public relations allows her to effectively navigate the complexities of the art market, ensuring that both buyers and sellers are well-informed and satisfied throughout the transaction process. Tina's ability to foster community outreach and her extensive knowledge of the arts further enhance her capacity to mediate successful deals, making her an invaluable asset to the collection.  
  
One of her key projects includes the successful exhibition of The Danish Art Collection at The Danish General Consulate in New York City in 2015, a significant event that garnered attention from the Danish American Association and highlighted the cultural ties between Denmark and the United States. Tina's multifaceted skills in composition, music education, and dance instruction complement her role, allowing her to approach art mediation with a unique, holistic perspective that celebrates the intersection of various artistic disciplines. Through her work, Tina Mariager continues to contribute to the promotion and appreciation of Danish art, ensuring its legacy endures in the contemporary cultural landscape.

SYBO Games is an independent game development studio, co-creators and IP right owners of one of the most played apps in the world Subway Surfers brought to life together with their awesome partners and friends at Kiloo Games. Having skyrocketed the charts with millions and millions of downloads across mobile devices and tablets since its May 2012 release, Subway Surfers have established itself among the most popular game apps in the world with a still rapidly expanding global market. To achieve this, the game studio has put all its focus in combining breathtaking animations and highly intuitive controls simple enough to play in one hand, but also sustaining a long-lasting and often humoristic gameplay for most ages. Today, the highest priorities in the company are developing core gameplay mechanics, concept development, cool character designs, stunning, cartoony graphics and sound designs that makes your ears happy. SYBO Games have mastered developing games in Unity for iOS, but have also expanded their activities to other platforms like Android and Amazon. The company was founded by CEO Bodie Jahn-Mulliner and Creative Director Sylvester Rishoej Jensen in 2010, and its headquarters is located in Copenhagen, Denmark.

IM Consultant Services is one of the world’s leading consulting firms. We work with business owners to help them create growth strategies, and help convert those strategies into actions and deliver the sustainable success they desire. We’re passionate about achieving better results for our clients.  
  
We advise global leaders on their most critical growth strategies and opportunities: strategy, digital marketing, digital transformation and strategy, advanced analytics, and branding.  
  
  
POWERED BY KNOWLEDGE  
Our work is founded on, not just a rigorous knowledge of internet marketing strategies and techniques, but also on how to combined the latest marketing strategies with business growth solutions.  
  
We study markets, trends, and emerging best practices and techniques, and customize the solution to match the needs of our clients.  
  
We partner with our clients, and together we create a custom solution that gets growth results. Each strategy is completely unique to the business needs and goals of our clients. We then work with our clients to put recommendations into practice and work directly with them over the long-term.  
  
  
ALWAYS INNOVATING  
Our clients’ needs are constantly changing, so we continually seek new and better ways to serve them. Strategies that worked last year are often made obsolete by an ever changing digital world.  
  
We not only stay on top of what is working today, but we also have proved repeatedly that we can anticipate where things are headed… thereby allowing you to not only keep up but also to surpass your competition.  
  
  
MIKE MARKO, CEO and FOUNDER  
  
Mike created IM Consultant Services with the vision of serving small and medium business owners with dependable services.  
  
A consultant with a lot of business and manufacturing experience, Mike has a keen sense for growth and marketing strategies.  
  
“It’s all about asking the right questions early on to learn about present success and future goals, and then working together to map out the best strategy that fits your needs.”  
  
A mechanical engineer with a Masters degree, Mike has had almost two decades of program management and new product development experience. He has brought together a great team here at IM Consultant Services to ensure top notch service for clients.  
  
Throughout his career, Mike has had to learn how to market ideas and concepts to both internal and external customers. Using lean process and manufacturing principles, he has the aptitude to create straight to the point marketing concepts that get results.

About Haikuo Zhang

Haikuo Zhang serves as the Director, Associate Director, and Senior Principal Scientist of Translational Research at GluBio Therapeutics Inc., where he plays a pivotal role in advancing innovative therapeutic strategies in oncology and immunology. With over a decade of experience in drug discovery and development, Haikuo has established himself as a leading expert in small molecules, targeted protein degradation, immunotherapy, and oncolytic viruses. His extensive background encompasses early drug discovery and target validation, where he has successfully identified and characterized novel therapeutic targets that have the potential to transform treatment paradigms.  
  
As a founding member of the translational research team, Haikuo is instrumental in supporting the discovery and development of both preclinical and clinical programs. His work includes biomarker discovery and validation, which are critical for patient stratification and ensuring that therapies are tailored to the right populations. He evaluates program differentiation strategies and indication selection, leveraging his deep understanding of pharmacodynamics and efficacy analysis through multiparameter flow cytometry (FACS) techniques. Additionally, Haikuo is adept at developing drug combination strategies that enhance therapeutic efficacy while minimizing resistance.  
  
His expertise in in vitro and in vivo pharmacology, coupled with a strong foundation in molecular biology, cell biology, and biochemistry, enables him to drive innovative research initiatives at GluBio. Haikuo's proficiency with animal models, transgenic mice, and advanced assay development further underscores his commitment to translating scientific discoveries into viable clinical applications. As he continues to push the boundaries of translational research, Haikuo Zhang remains dedicated to improving patient outcomes through cutting-edge therapeutic solutions.

About Nederlands Instituut voor Beeld en Geluid
-----------------------------------------------

The Netherlands Institute for Sound & Vision (Sound & Vision) maintains and provides access to over 70 per cent of the Dutch audio-visual heritage, comprising more than one million hours of television, radio, music and film, making it one of the largest audiovisual archives in Europe. Sound & Vision combines the highest professional standards concerning the release and storage of material, with easy access for its users, by using state of the art systems for asset management and storage.  
Sound & Vision is the business archive of the national broadcasting corporations as well as a cultural heritage institute. Sound & Vision has brought thousands of hours of archive footage on-line for educational use and also operates a facility for the general public, the Media Experience, which is visited by 200,000 people annually. In 2007, the seven-year Images for the Future programme was launched. The project, funded with a budget of €154 million from the FES Fund, will realise the digitisation of the Netherlands’ audiovisual memory in a process whereby Sound & Vision will conserve and digitise 17,500 hours of film, 124,000 hours of audio, 137,000 hours of video and 1.2 million photos. This material will be made available for (broadcast) professionals, education and the general public. In the scope of this project, Sound & Vision is experimenting with crowdsourcing.

Can Hillenbrand customize solutions for specific customer needs?

What is the role of talent development at Hillenbrand?

Talent development is a key focus at Hillenbrand, as we believe that our employees are our greatest asset. Five years since opening our doors as North America’s first fully digital hospital and we remain unwavering in our belief that we can change the hospital where we work, the community where we live, and the world of healthcare beyond our borders. Serving a community of 850,000 residents in North West Toronto, Equity Inclusivity and active participation in the North West Toronto Ontario Health Team are key initiatives that are important to our Team.  
  
At Humber River Hospital, we use a custom combination of technology and clinical expertise to rebuild elements of care. We make technology work for staff and physicians; giving them more time to spend with patients, to eliminate inefficiencies, and to reduce the chance of errors.  
  
We are formally affiliated with both the University of Toronto and Queen’s University and committed to becoming a community academic hospital. Clinical Excellence, Optimizing Care Through Technology and Community Connection frame our Research Strategy.  
  
At Humber River Hospital, we’re not hoping for a renaissance, we are making it happen. As part of our dynamic team, you can lead the way, as we continue our journey towards high reliability care!

About Florida Municipal Power Agency
------------------------------------

Florida Municipal Power Agency (FMPA) is a wholesale power agency owned by 31 municipal electric utilities. FMPA’s mission is to provide power that is competitively priced, reliable and clean, as well as provide value-added services for its owner-customers. Our members serve approximately two million Floridians.  
  
Each FMPA member is locally owned and operated, but they work together on common needs. For example, by coordinating the power supply needs of several communities, the utilities can build larger, more efficient power plants and share operating expenses, all of which reduces the cost of electricity.  
  
FMPA has six power supply projects. We supply all or some of the power 24 of our 31 members. Some cities do not purchase power from FMPA, but utilize other services from the Agency.

About Johnson Plastics
----------------------

Johnson Plastics Plus, headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota, has been a leading supplier to the engraving and sign making industry since 1970. We built our business on the belief that a strong customer focus is as important to the business as the products that are sold.  
  
In 2017, Johnson Plastics was rebranded as Johnson Plastics Plus after integrating with Bur-Lane, Inc., a manufacturer and distributor of engraving plastic and identification accessories and supplies. A short time later, LaserBits, a wholesaler of laser materials and training, also joined our Johnson Plastics Plus family, and we are now pleased to offer LaserBits’ entire product range.  
  
Johnson Plastics is always prepared to serve our national customer base with nine conveniently located branch offices and warehouses -- California, Texas, Ohio, Georgia, Illinois, Oklahoma, Arizona, Pennsylvania, and New York. We are also proud to feature the Guaranteed In-Stock program, which ensures that our most popular items will always be available for our customers.  
  
Originally one of the charter distributors of Rowmark engraving materials, Johnson Plastics was acquired by Rowmark, LLC in 2015 in order to better serve the engraving industry.  
  
Johnson Plastics Plus entered the sublimation arena in 2002. Partnering with Unisub, Sawgrass, Vapor Apparel, Geo Knight and several other vendors, we have become a dominant force in sublimation.  
  
Knowledgeable and friendly customer service representatives are eager to take your order or answer questions about our products. Johnson Plastics Plus’ Customer Service Representatives have an average of 10 years of experience and have developed lasting relationships with our customers to better serve your needs. Online ordering is available 24/7. Product is normally shipped within 24 hours of receipt of your order. Our Johnson Plastics Plus commitment to serving the needs of the engraving, sublimation and sign making customers remains our primary focus.

About Charlie Crist

Charlie Crist, the former Governor of Florida, is a dynamic and influential political figure who has made a significant impact on the state's governance. Known for his amiable persona and pragmatic leadership style, Crist has been a prominent figure in Florida politics for several decades.  
  
Born in Altoona, Pennsylvania, Crist moved to St. Petersburg, Florida, during his childhood and developed a deep love for the state. He attended Florida State University, where he earned his undergraduate and law degrees. Early on, Crist showed a keen interest in public service and embarked on a career that would make him one of Florida's most recognizable political figures.  
  
Crist began his political journey in the Florida State Senate, serving from 1993 to 1999. During his tenure, he made significant contributions to education reform and environmental protection, demonstrating his commitment to improving the lives of Florida residents. His ability to build bipartisan support and seek common ground earned him a reputation as a consensus-driven leader, distinguishing him from many politicians of his time.  
  
In 2003, Crist was elected as Florida's Attorney General, a position he held until 2007. As Attorney General, Crist cracked down on fraud and brought attention to critical issues such as identity theft and predatory lending. His dedication to protecting Floridians and ensuring justice earned him respect across party lines and positioned him as a formidable contender in the upcoming gubernatorial election.  
  
In 2006, Crist successfully ran for Governor of Florida, winning the election with a wide margin. His tenure as Governor was marked by a focus on economic recovery and education reform. In response to the global financial crisis, Crist implemented policies to stimulate economic growth and create jobs in Florida. His efforts were widely commended, leading to significant improvements in the state's economic indicators.  
  
Education was another key area of concern for Crist during his time as Governor. He prioritized investing in Florida's education system, advocating for increased funding and improved resources for schools. Crist also championed accessible higher education, making college more affordable for thousands of Florida students through initiatives such as the Bright Futures Scholarship Program. His relentless commitment to education equality and student success helped transform Florida's education landscape.  
  
Furthermore, Crist prioritized environmental protection and sustainability during his tenure. Aware of the ecological treasures present in the state, he implemented policies to safeguard Florida's natural resources, enhance clean energy production, and combat climate change. Crist's efforts to preserve the Everglades, regulate water usage, and promote renewable energy sources were widely acclaimed both nationally and internationally.  
  
Despite his accomplishments as Governor, Crist faced challenges within his own party that ultimately led to a significant political shift. In 2010, he decided to pursue a U.S. Senate seat, but faced stiff opposition from within the Republican Party during the primary election. Notably, he faced criticism for his support of President Barack Obama's stimulus package. The pressure from conservative factions ultimately led Crist to leave the Republican Party and run as an independent candidate. Though he lost the Senate race, his decision to leave the Republican Party showcased his willingness to put principle above party loyalty.  
  
Subsequently, Crist made a notable political transformation by joining the Democratic Party in 2012. He ran for Governor once again in 2014, this time as a Democrat. Although he did not win the election, his campaign resonated with many Floridians who admired his inclusive leadership style and moderate, practical approach to governance.  
  
Since his last gubernatorial campaign, Crist has remained active in politics, seeking opportunities to serve Florida in different capacities. His dedication to public service and his unwavering commitment to the Sunshine State and its residents continue to shape his political trajectory. Whether as Governor, Attorney General, or a candidate seeking elected office, Charlie Crist exemplifies a unique blend of charisma, pragmatism, and bipartisanship, making him an influential figure in Florida's political landscape.

What types of consulting services does Acuity Consulting, Inc. offer?

Acuity Consulting, Inc. specializes in a variety of consulting services tailored for the federal government and the Department of Defense (DoD). Our primary offerings include management consulting, financial management, IT solutions, program management, acquisition management, and audit and audit readiness services. We focus on helping our clients improve operational efficiency, ensure compliance, and enhance overall performance.

How does Acuity assist with audit readiness for federal agencies?

Acuity provides comprehensive audit readiness services designed to prepare federal agencies for successful audits. Our approach includes conducting thorough internal control assessments, identifying gaps in compliance, and implementing corrective actions to enhance financial reporting processes. We work closely with our clients to develop tailored strategies that ensure they meet federal audit requirements and improve their overall audit outcomes.

What industries does Acuity Consulting serve?

Acuity Consulting primarily serves the federal government, with a strong focus on the Department of Defense (DoD). Our expertise extends to various sectors within the government, including defense contracting, financial management, and IT solutions. We leverage our deep understanding of military and government operations to provide effective consulting services that address the unique challenges faced by these industries.

Can Acuity help with program management for government projects?

Yes, Acuity Consulting offers robust program management services tailored for government projects. Our experienced consultants work with clients to develop and implement effective program management strategies that ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and in alignment with regulatory requirements. We utilize best practices and proven methodologies to enhance project delivery and drive successful outcomes.

What is the process for engaging Acuity Consulting for services?

Engaging Acuity Consulting begins with an initial consultation to understand your specific needs and challenges. Our team will assess your requirements and propose a customized solution that aligns with your goals. Once an agreement is reached, we will develop a detailed project plan, establish timelines, and assign dedicated resources to ensure the successful execution of our services. We prioritize open communication and collaboration throughout the engagement.

Does Acuity provide training or support for internal control assessments?

Yes, Acuity Consulting offers training and support for internal control assessments. We believe that empowering your team with the necessary knowledge and skills is crucial for maintaining effective internal controls. Our training programs cover best practices in internal control frameworks, compliance requirements, and audit preparation. Additionally, we provide ongoing support to help your organization implement and sustain these controls effectively.

About ☁Jeroen Vries

As an IACS Cybersecurity Specialist at Hoogheemraadschap van Delfland, Jeroen Vries plays a pivotal role in safeguarding the operational technology (OT) environment critical to the water management systems of the region. With a robust background in IT security, Jeroen is dedicated to implementing stringent cybersecurity measures that adhere to the BIO, NIS2, and CSIR (IEC 62443) guidelines. His expertise is particularly vital in securing the infrastructure of water systems and wastewater treatment plants (AWZI's), ensuring that these essential services remain resilient against emerging cyber threats.  
  
Jeroen's current projects involve the development and implementation of SCADA Security Best Practices, which are crucial for protecting supervisory control and data acquisition systems from potential vulnerabilities. He actively guides penetration testing initiatives within the OT environment, working closely with IT architects and Security Operations Centers (SOC) to identify and mitigate risks. His role as a sparring partner fosters collaboration across teams, enhancing the overall security posture of the organization.  
  
With certifications as a Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect Expert, OT certified IACS IEC 62443 professional, and Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), Jeroen brings a wealth of knowledge in IT/OT security, networking, and virtualization. His comprehensive skill set, including proficiency in Windows Server, SharePoint, Microsoft Exchange, and PowerShell, empowers him to address complex security challenges effectively. Jeroen's philosophy—"It's better to have it and not need it than to need it and not have it"—drives his proactive approach to cybersecurity, ensuring that Hoogheemraadschap van Delfland remains at the forefront of protecting its critical water infrastructure.

About Drucker School of Management
----------------------------------

The Drucker School of Management, located in Claremont, California, is a distinguished institution that embodies the principles of renowned management thinker Peter F. Drucker. With a mission centered on responsible management as the cornerstone of societal progress, the school emphasizes the importance of purpose-driven and human-centered leadership. At the Drucker School, we believe that effective management goes beyond profit; it is about fostering human thriving within organizations. Our curriculum is designed to cultivate innovative and change-oriented leaders who are equipped to tackle the complexities of the modern business landscape.  
  
The Drucker School values community and social responsibility, promoting diversity, equity, and inclusion while adhering to ethical practices that benefit society as a whole. Our faculty, comprised of experienced educators and industry practitioners, is dedicated to delivering a results-oriented education that is both practical and globally relevant. Students engage with a rich array of courses that prioritize accountability and aim to enhance organizational performance across various sectors.  
  
For those interested in exploring the academic credentials of our esteemed faculty, a comprehensive Drucker School of Management teachers list is available on our website. This resource highlights the diverse expertise and backgrounds of our instructors, who are committed to guiding the next generation of leaders in their pursuit of excellence. By integrating Drucker’s philosophies into our teaching and research, we prepare our students to make meaningful contributions to their organizations and society at large.

What is Plooto and how does it simplify accounts payable and receivable?

Plooto is an all-in-one accounts payable (AP) and receivable (AR) platform designed to streamline financial operations for businesses. With Plooto, businesses can manage their cash flow more effectively, reduce manual errors, and save time on administrative tasks, allowing them to focus on growth and strategy.

What types of payments can I process using Plooto?

Plooto supports a variety of payment types, including ACH payments, international payments, and pre-authorized debit transactions. The platform is designed for B2B transactions, making it ideal for businesses that need to send and receive payments efficiently. Additionally, Plooto integrates seamlessly with popular accounting software like QuickBooks and Xero, allowing for easy bill payment and reconciliation.

Is Plooto suitable for businesses of all sizes?

Yes, Plooto is suitable for businesses of all sizes, from small startups to large enterprises. How does Plooto handle international payments?

The platform supports multiple currencies and ensures compliance with international payment regulations. This allows businesses to expand their reach and transact with clients and suppliers globally, all while maintaining transparency and control over their financial operations.

Can Plooto integrate with my existing accounting software?

Absolutely! Plooto integrates seamlessly with popular accounting software such as QuickBooks and Xero. This integration allows for automatic syncing of financial data, making it easier to manage invoices, track payments, and reconcile accounts. By using Plooto alongside your existing accounting tools, you can enhance your financial workflows and reduce the risk of errors.

What security measures does Plooto implement to protect my financial data?

Plooto takes security seriously and employs robust measures to protect your financial data. The platform uses encryption protocols to secure data in transit and at rest, ensuring that sensitive information is safeguarded. Additionally, Plooto complies with industry standards and regulations to maintain the highest level of security. Regular audits and monitoring are conducted to identify and mitigate potential risks, providing peace of mind for users.

His leadership is characterized by a collaborative approach, ensuring that all team members adhere to architectural standards and contribute effectively to project goals. How does NAVA ensure data security during cloud migration?

NAVA prioritizes data security during cloud migration by implementing industry best practices and compliance standards. Our team is trained to handle sensitive data securely, providing peace of mind to our clients throughout the migration process.

Andrii Danylov currently serves as a Staff Software Engineer at Panasonic Automotive, where he leverages his extensive expertise in embedded systems and computer vision to drive innovation in advanced automotive technologies. Among his key projects, Andrii is actively involved in the development of the Laser Vector Graphic Unit with MEMS technology, a project that exemplifies his commitment to pushing the boundaries of automotive display systems. His proficiency in programming languages such as C and C++14, combined with his experience in embedded Linux and ARM architectures, allows him to tackle complex challenges in real-time systems. Additionally, Andrii's skills in test automation and the Yocto project enable him to streamline development processes, ensuring robust and reliable software solutions.  
  
As the automotive industry increasingly embraces autonomous vehicle technologies, Andrii's insights into computer vision and OpenCV are invaluable. His ability to integrate sophisticated algorithms into practical applications positions him as a key contributor to Panasonic Automotive's mission of enhancing driver experience and safety through innovative technology. With a keen focus on the future of mobility, Andrii Danylov is not just shaping products; he is helping to redefine the way we interact with our vehicles.

About COMET
-----------

COMET is a transformational brand founded by a group of visionaries who approach problems differently. We supply naturally better ingredients that make it easy for people to eat healthier and have a positive impact on the planet. Sustainability, science and health are at the heart of everything we do.  
  
COMET is the only company with the IP and expertise needed to perfect nature's best fiber, arabinoxylan, an FDA-recognized fiber with superior tolerance in the gut and clinically proven prebiotic health benefits. COMET's proprietary line of Arrabina arabinoxylan dietary fibers are upcycled certified and can easily be added to any food and beverage application.  
  
Our small, but mighty team is comprised of intelligent and imaginative talent who work collaboratively to ensure innovation, success and exponential growth. We are fully funded after raising $25M in Series C funding, led by well-known investors such as Louis Dreyfus and Open Prairie. COMET is actively increasing commercialization of its line of Arrabina dietary fibers to meet the strong market demand.

### Frequently Asked Questions about COMET

Who is the CEO of COMET?

Eric Didier is the CEO of COMET. To contact Eric Didier email at [\[email protected\]](https://contactout.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)

Who are the decision makers in COMET?

The decision makers in COMET are [Adam Muir](https://contactout.com/Adam-Muir-904528)

What types of ingredients does COMET provide?

COMET specializes in supplying naturally better ingredients that focus on sustainability and health. Our offerings include prebiotics, dietary fibers, and innovative food ingredients designed to enhance digestive health and support gut microbiome balance. We prioritize upcycled ingredients that not only improve nutrition but also reduce food waste.

How does COMET contribute to sustainability in the food industry?

COMET is committed to sustainability through our focus on upcycling and innovative food technology. We source ingredients that minimize environmental impact and promote a circular economy. By transforming food by-products into valuable ingredients, we help reduce waste while providing healthier options for consumers.

What industries can benefit from COMET's solutions?

COMET's solutions are applicable across various industries, including food and beverage, dietary supplements, and health and wellness. Our ingredients can be used in products aimed at improving digestive health, reducing sugar content, and enhancing overall nutritional value, making them ideal for manufacturers looking to innovate and meet consumer demands for healthier options.

Can COMET help with sugar reduction in food products?

Yes, COMET offers innovative ingredients that can help manufacturers reduce sugar content in their products without compromising taste. Our solutions include natural sweeteners and fiber-rich ingredients that not only enhance flavor but also contribute to overall health, making it easier for brands to create healthier alternatives for consumers.

What are prebiotics, and how do they benefit gut health?

Prebiotics are non-digestible food components that promote the growth of beneficial bacteria in the gut. COMET provides high-quality prebiotic ingredients that support digestive health, improve gut microbiome balance, and enhance overall well-being. Incorporating prebiotics into food products can lead to improved digestion and better nutrient absorption for consumers.

How does COMET ensure the quality and safety of its ingredients?

COMET prioritizes quality and safety by adhering to strict industry standards and conducting rigorous testing of all our ingredients. We work closely with suppliers to ensure that our products are sustainably sourced and meet the highest safety and quality benchmarks. Our commitment to transparency and quality assurance helps our partners deliver safe and effective products to consumers.

About CLARCOR Industrial Air
----------------------------

CLARCOR Industrial Air, headquartered in Overland Park, US, USA with locations in the US, China, UK & Germany. Focused on Industrial Filtration (IF)/Pollution Control, Gas Turbine (GT) Filtration and Specialty Products: Performance Fabrics & Microfiltration & Venting.  
  
The IF business brings together the strengths of the BHA® and United Air Specialists (UAS®) dust, mist and fume collection equipment: SmogHog®, DustHog® and Kleentek®. No matter the application, from process industries to power generation, we have the strongest filtration offering in the market. Launching five new products this year and continuing development of patented media’s and technology we deliver the most comprehensive solutions. We protect employees, help customers remain compliant & improve plant performance.  
  
The GT Filtration business delivers a full range of inlet systems & filters engineered to meet the operating goals of our customers within all segments of the GT industry through the altair® & clearcurrent® brands. Our PRO (Predictable Reliable Output) technology delivers improved output and reliability by reducing compressor degradation, and our best-in-class portfolio ensures turbine availability and performance. We help power plant operators with reliable and improved performance while oil & gas operators benefit from extended GT availability and maximum protection against corrosion and fouling. With our ability to design filtration systems to meet any environmental challenge, our solutions are unmatched.  
  
With 850+ employees globally and 50 years in the business we have the expertise and innovative solutions to optimize the performance, profitability and safety of customers’ plants & manufacturing operations. We provide answers, not just products  
  
Specialties  
Offshore Oil & Gas, Marine and Energy & Electric Utilities Gas Turbine Inlet Systems and Filters, Specialty Membrane, Microfiltration & Media, Industrial Filtration Dust & Mist Collection Equipment & Filters

About San Andreas Regional Center

Who We Are  
San Andreas Regional Center is a community-based, private nonprofit corporation funded by the State of California to serve people with developmental disabilities as required by the Lanterman Developmental Disabilities Act. The Lanterman Act is part of California law that sets out the rights and responsibilities of persons with developmental disabilities. San Andreas is one of 21 regional centers throughout California serving individuals and their families who reside within Monterey, San Benito, Santa Clara, and Santa Cruz Counties.  
  
Services Provided  
Once an individual’s eligibility has been determined through the Intake process, service coordination and planning is initiated with the development of a person centered written plan. Services are individually determined and are provided to assist with opportunities to maximize consumers’ opportunities to live independent productive and satisfying lives as members of our community.  
  
Mission Statement  
San Andreas Regional Center Mission Statement recognizes the ongoing need for advocacy to sustain the original intent and promise of the Lanterman Developmental Disabilities Act and commits itself to protecting its provisions.  
  
Equal Opportunity Employer  
San Andreas Regional Center is an Equal Opportunity Employer. About RMT Valvomeccanica
------------------------

The company is one of the oldest valve manufacturer in Italy. Since 1950 design and manufacture were concentrated on lubricated plug valves in standard and inverted pressure-balanced designs. For 40 years the company operated successfully improving its skills and capabilities, up to the beginning of the ‘90s when the company was liquidated due to market changes and the growing attention of the owners to forgings and ball valves production.  
In 1998 the activity found a new beginning with the name “La Valvomeccanica S.p.A.”, incorporated in Solbiate Olona (VA) as a public limited company specialized in small and medium ball valves. In the same year, “RMT Valves s.r.l.” was established in Voghera (PV), as a trading company supplying service to major worldwide Engineering & Construction companies for all types of on-off valves: ball, gate, globe, check, butterfly and plug. In 2008 the good collaboration between the two companies led to the merger of the two companies into “RMT Valvomeccanica s.r.l.”.  
RMT VALVOMECCANICA is included in the GIVA group, an Italian group founded by Mr. Antonio Vienna in 1962 in Northern Italy, which performed in 2008 a turnover exceeding 650 Million Euro. Actually the group includes steel mills, such as Italfond, and important forge masters, such as Forgiatura A.Vienna, which can supply big forgings up to 120 tons and shell rings up to 8 meters in diameter, with a wide range of materials.  
Supported by the international experience and the innovation of the group, in the last years the company improved products quality and customers satisfaction. Moreover RMT Valvomeccanica has risen to the top of the market thanks to its competitiveness and the capacity to adapt to the continuous evolutions occurring within the market itself.  
The factory and headquarter of the company are located in the town of Solbiate Olona, just North of Milan in the very heart of the Italian and European valve industry.

About Fort Wayne Metals
-----------------------

We are a leading manufacturer of precision wire-based materials and components used in the world's most demanding applications. At Fort Wayne Metals, our people develop new alloys, pioneer revolutionary materials, and never stop refining our products to help them perform better in our customers' applications around the world.  
  
We offer access to a breadth of materials, including round wire, flat wire, shaped wire, bar, strands and cables, DFT® composite wire, DBS® wire, HHS® tube, SLT® wire, titanium and titanium alloys, Nitinol and a range of high-performance alloys.  
  
Our portfolio of services includes mechanical custom assembly, custom alloy development, research and development, coating, and laser ablation.  
  
We work with wire diameters from as small as 0.0127 mm \[.0005 in\] to 12.7 mm \[0.500 in\]. We are FDA registered and ISO 9001, AS 9100D and ISO 13485 certified.  
  
Fort Wayne Metals is here to customize our products to meet the functional and mechanical needs of your devices. Reach out to a member of our team to see how our precision materials can help advance the performance of your devices.
